51.text: Na sintong tumang do hatang-Kon bani nasiam, barang ise na mangkorjahon hatang-Ku, seng idahonni hamatean sadokah ni dokahni.”

52.text: Nini halak Jahudi ma hu Bani, “Sonari ibotoh hanami ma, na sibolison do Ham. Na matei do si Abraham ampa nabi-nabi, hape Ham mangkatahon, ʻBarang ise na mangkorjahon hatang-Kin, seng dageion ni in hamatean sadokah ni dokahni.

53.text: Ai banggalan do Ham humbani bapanami si Abraham, na dob matei in? Anjaha nabi-nabi pe matei do. Ai ise do Ham, ninuhur-Mu?”

54.text: Ibalosi Jesus ma, “Anggo Ahu pasangap diring-Ku, na so adong ma sangap-Ku. Adong do Bapang-Ku, na pasangap Ahu, in ma na hinatahon nasiam Bapa nasiam.

55.text: Anjaha seng itanda nasiam Ia, tapi anggo Ahu Hutanda do. Ambit Huhatahon, seng Hutanda Ia, parladung ma Ahu songon nasiam. Tapi Hutanda do Ia, anjaha Hudalankon do hata-Ni.

56.text: Marolob-olob do si Abraham, bapa nasiam in, halani sihol idahonni ari-Kin, jadi saud do ididah, gabe malas ma uhurni.”

57.text: Dob ai nini halak Jahudi ma hu Bani, “Lima puluh tahun pe lape das umur-Mu, mintor ongga ma ididah Ham si Abraham?”

58.text: Nini Jesus ma hubani sidea, “Na sintong tumang do na Huhatahon on bani nasiam, lape tubuh si Abraham, domma adong Ahu.”

59.text: Jadi ibuat sidea ma batu, laho manggijigi-Si, tapi ponop ma Jesus misir hun rumah panumbahan ai.

1.text: Dob ai sanggah na montas Ia, ididah ma sada halak na pitung humbani partubuhni.
1.title: Ipamalum Jesus Sada Halak na Mapitung Tubuh Sanggah Ari Sabat

2.text: Jadi nini susian-Ni ai ma manungkun-Si, “Guru, ise do na mardousa, halak on do atap namatorasni, ase pitung ia humbani partubuhni?”

3.text: Ibalosi Jesus ma, “Sedo halani dousani atap halani dousa ni namatorasni, tapi ase ipatalar bani horja ni Naibata.

4.text: Maningon horjahonon-Ku do horja ni na marsuruh Ahu, sadokah siang ari; ai rohkonsi borngin, seng tarbahen atap ise pe marhorja.

5.text: Sadokah i dunia on Ahu, panondang ni dunia on do Ahu.”

6.text: Dob ihatahon sonai, martijur ma Ia hu tanoh, laho pamalhot tanoh otik marhitei tijur-Ni ai, idaiskon ma na malhot ai bani matani,

7.text: lanjar nini ma hu bani, “Laho ma ham marsuhap hu bongbongan Siloam (artini: na sinuruh).” Jadi laho ma ia marsuhap, gabe marpangidah ma ia mulak hunjai.

8.text: Jadi nini romban rumahni ma, sonai age na ongga mangidahsi hinan mangindo-indo, “Ai lang on do, na hundul mangindo-indo ondi?”

9.text: Na deba mangkatahon, “Ia do in!” Na deba nari mangkatahon, “Lang, tapi usih do ia hujai!” Ia sandiri mangkatahon, “Ahu do in!”

10.text: Nini sidea ma hu bani, “Sonaha do parmungkab ni matamu in?”

11.text: Nini ma mambalosi, “Sada halak, na margoran Jesus pamalhot tanoh. Idaiskon ma ai bani matangku, anjaha ihatahon ma ahu marsuhap hu bongbongan Siloam. Jadi laho ma ahu marsuhap, gabe marpangidah ma.”

12.text: Dob ai nini sidea ma bani, “Ija do Ia?” Balosni, “Seng hubotoh!”

13.text: Jadi iarahkon sidea ma na pitung hinan ai hu lobei ni Parisei.

14.text: Tapi ari Sabat do tudu, sanggah na pinamalhot ni Jesus tanoh ai, anjaha na niungkab-Ni ai matani ai.
14.title: Sogam ni Uhur ni Halak Parisei

15.text: Lanjar isungkun Parisei ai ma ia, atap sonaha do, ase marpangidah ia. Jadi nini ma hubani sidea, “Tanoh na pinamalhot do idaiskon bani matangku, dob ai marsuhap ma ahu, gabe marpangidah ma ahu.”

16.text: Piga-piga halak Parisei ai mangkatahon, “Seng na humbani Naibata Halak ai, ai seng ihargahon ari Sabat.” Na legan mangkatahon, “Mintor tarhorjahon pardousa ma tanda na sonai ai?” Jadi marsalisih ma sidea samah sidea.

17.text: Dob ai ihatahon sidea ma use bani halak na pitung ai, “Ia ho, sonaha do pangkatahonmu pasal-Si, halani iungkab matamu?” Jadi nini ma, “Nabi do Ia.”

18.text: Seng iparhatongon Jahudi ai, na pitung hinan do ia, dob ai marpangidah use, pala idilo sidea namatoras ni na gabe marpangidah ai,

19.text: anjaha isungkun ma sidea, “Anak nasiam do on, na hinatahon nasiam ai pitung humbani partubuhni? Na sonaha do, ase marpangidah ia nuan?”

20.text: Jadi nini namatorasni ai ma mambalosi sidea, “Tongon do on anaknami, anjaha pitung do ia tubuh.

21.text: Sonaha, ase marpangidah ia sonari, seng ibotoh hanami, anjaha ise na mangungkab matani in, seng itanda hanami. Ia ma sungkun nasiam, domma sungkup umurni, domma boi ia marsahap pasal dirini.”

22.text: Ase sonai pe hata ni namatorasni ai, halani mabiar do sidea mangidah halak Jahudi ai. Ai domma manriah halak Jahudi, maningon sipabalion do hun kuria, barang ise na marhatongonkon Kristus do Ia.

23.text: Halani ai do ase ihatahon namatorasni ai, “Domma sungkup umurni, ia ma sungkun nasiam.”

24.text: Dob ai idilo sidea ma paduahalihon na pitung ondi, nini sidea ma hu bani, “Pasangap ma Naibata! Ibotoh hanami, pardousa do Halak ai!”

25.text: Jadi nini ma mambalosi, “Barang pardousa Ia seng hubotoh. Pitah on do na hubotoh, mapitung do ahu hinan, tapi marpangidah do nuan.”

26.text: Dob ai nini sidea ma hu bani, “Ai aha ibahen bam? Sonaha do ibahen mangungkab matamu?”

27.text: Ibalosi ma sidea, “Domma hupatugah ai bani nasiam, na so ibogei nasiam do in? Sonaha, sihol bogeion nasiam use? Sihol nasiam gabe susian-Ni?”

28.text: Jadi isuraki sidea ma ia, nini ma, “Ho do susian-Ni, anggo hanami susian ni si Musa do.

29.text: Ibotoh hanami, na iparsahapkon Naibata do si Musa, tapi anggo Halak on, seng nabotoh, atap na hunja Ia.”

30.text: Jadi nini ma mambalosi sidea, “Halongangan ma in tongon na so ibotoh nasiam atap na hunja Ia, hape iungkap do matangku!

31.text: Ibotoh hita do, na so itangihon Naibata pardousa, tapi na marhabiaran Bani, anjaha sihorjahon rosuh ni uhur-Ni, ai do itangihon.

32.text: Hun bani sapari, seng ongga nabogei, adong na mangungkab mata ni halak na mapitung tubuh.

33.text: Ambit seng humbani Naibata Ia, seng tarbahensi age aha.”

34.text: Jadi nini sidea ma hu bani, “Hibul do ho tubuh ibagas dousa, hape sihol ajaranmu hanami?” Jadi ipabali sidea ma ia.

35.text: Itangar Jesus ma, na dob ipabali sidea ia. Dob jumpah-Si ia, nini ma, “Porsaya do ho bani Anak ni Jolma in?”
35.title: Balos ni Jesus Bani Halak Jahudi

36.text: Jadi nini ma mambalosi, “Ai ise do ai Tuan, ase porsaya ahu Bani?”

37.text: Nini Jesus ma hu bani, “Na nididahmu, anjaha na marsahap pakon ho, in ma Ia.”

38.text: Jadi nini ma, “Na porsaya do Ahu, Tuhan!” Lanjar isombah ma Ia.

39.text: Dob ai ihatahon Jesus ma, “Mamboan uhum do ase roh Ahu hu dunia on, ase marpangidah na so marpangidah hinan, anjaha na marpangidah hinan gabe mapitung.”

40.text: Ibogei deba halak Parisei na rap pakonsi ai ma ai, gabe nini ma dompak-Si, “Ai dihut do hanami pitung?”

41.text: Nini Jesus ma hubani sidea, “Ambit pitung nasiam, seng mardousa nasiam. Tapi halani ihatahon nasiam, ʻMarpangidah do hanami,ʼ gabe totap ma dousa nasiam.”

1.text: “Na sintong tumang do na Huhatahon on bani nasiam, barang ise na so masuk hun labah, laho hu harang ni biribiri, tapi manangkih humbani dalan na legan, panangko do ai anjaha panrampok.
1.title: Parmahan Na Madear

2.text: Tapi na masuk hun labah, ai do siparmahan bani biribiri ai.

3.text: Ungkabon ni sijaga labah ai ma bani, anjaha itangihon biribiri ai do sorani; idilo do sidea bani goranni bei, anjaha iboan hu darat.

4.text: Dob ipadarat haganup na adong bani ai, sai i lobei do ia mardalan, anjaha iirikkon biribiri ai do ia, ai itanda sidea do sorani.

5.text: Halak na legan nani, seng ra sidea mangihutkon ai, tapi maporus do sidea hun bani, ai seng itanda sidea sora ni na legan ai.”

6.text: Limbaga on ma ihatahon Jesus bani sidea, tapi seng iarusi sidea, na hinatahon-Ni ai bani sidea.

7.text: Jadi nini Jesus ma use bani sidea, “Na sintong tumang do na Huhatahon on bani nasiam, Ahu do labah laho hubani biribiri in.

8.text: Haganup na manlobei Ahu panangko do in anjaha panrampok, tapi seng itangihon biribiri in sidea.

9.text: Ahu do labah in; barang ise na masuk hun Bangku, maluah do, kaluar masuk ma ia, anjaha dapotan sampalan.

10.text: Roh pe panangko, pitah na laho manangko, na manayati ampa mangagou do hansa. Roh do Ahu ase dong hagoluhan bani sidea, anjaha marlobih-lobih.

11.text: Parmahan Na Madear do Ahu. Ibere Parmahan Na Madear do hosah-Ni mangkopkop biribiri-Ni.

12.text: Tapi anggo sipangan gaji, na so siparmahan, na so simada biribiri in, ididah pe roh begu, itadingkon do biribiri in laho lintun, gabe isoroh begu ai ma biribiri in anjaha mambur merap ibahen,

13.text: ai sipangan gaji do ia, na so mansarihon biribiri in.

14.text: Ahu do Parmahan Na Madear, Hutanda do na Bangku, anjaha itanda sidea do Ahu,

15.text: songon Bapa mananda Ahu, anjaha Ahu mananda Bapa. Hubere do hosah-Ku mangkopkop biribiring-Ku,

16.text: Adong ope biribiring-Ku na legan, na so humbani harang on. Sidea pe dihut do arahkonon-Ku, anjaha tangihonon ni sidea do sorang-Ku, gabe sada hulanan ma ai anjaha sada parmahan.

17.text: Halani on do, ase ihaholongi Bapa in Ahu, halani Huberehon hosah-Ku, ase Hujalo ai use.

18.text: Seng dong na mambuat in hun Bangku, humbani rosuh-Ku do in Hubere. Na markuasa do Ahu mamberehon, anjaha na markuasa do Ahu use manjalo in. In ma titah na Hujalo humbani Bapa.”

19.text: Tubuh ma use parsalisihan i tongah-tongah ni halak Jahudi halani hata ai.

20.text: Buei do humbani sidea na mangkatahon, “Na sibolison do In anjaha na podouan! Mase ma patangi-tangionnima In?”

21.text: Na legan mangkatahon, “Sedo sahap ni na sibolison in! Mintor tarungkab sibolis ma mata ni na mapitung?”

22.text: Dob ai jumpah ma use pesta pabayu rumah panumbahan i Jerusalem, musim borgoh do ijia.
22.title: Sahap ni Jesus Sanggah Pesta Pabayu Rumah Panumbahan

23.text: Mardalan-dalan do Jesus i emper ni si Salomo, na i rumah panumbahan ai.

24.text: Roh ma halak Jahudi manginggoti-Si, nini sidea ma, “Sadiha dokah on sungkun-sungkun uhurnami bahenon-Mu? Anggo Ham do Kristus in, hatahon Ham ma torang bennami.”

25.text: Balos ni Jesus bani sidea, “Domma Hupatugah bani nasiam, tapi seng porsaya nasiam. Horja na Huhorjahon marhitei goran ni Bapa, ai do manaksihon pasal Ahu.

26.text: Tapi seng porsaya nasiam, ai seng masuk biribiring-Ku nasiam.

27.text: Itangihon biribiring-Ku do sora-Ku, anjaha itanda sidea do Ahu, iirikkon sidea do Ahu.

28.text: Hubere do bani sidea hagoluhan na sadokah ni dokahni; seng magou sidea sadokah ni dokahni, anjaha ise pe lang boi manrampas sidea humbani tangan-Ku.

29.text: Banggalan humbani haganup do Bapa, na mamberehon sidea ai Bangku, anjaha ise pe lang boi manrampas sidea humbani tangan ni Bapa.

30.text: Sada do Ahu pakon Bapa in.”

31.text: Dob ai ibuat halak Jahudi ma use batu, laho manggijig-Si.

32.text: Tapi nini Jesus ma hubani sidea, “Buei do horja na madear humbani Bapa Hupatuduhkon bani nasiam. Halani horja do, ase sihol pargijigon nasiam Ahu?”

33.text: Balos ni halak Jahudi, “Sedo halani horja na madear, ase sihol pargijigonnami Ham, tapi halani pangapasi-Mu ai do, ai ipados Ham do diri-Mu pakon Naibata, age pe jolma do Ham.”

34.text: Dob ai ibalosi Jesus ma sidea, “Ai lang adong do tarsurat bani titah nasiam, ʻDomma Huhatahon, Naibata do nasiam?ʼ

35.text: Anggo igoran Naibata, hadasan ni hata ni Naibata, anjaha seng tarkahua Surat in,

36.text: mase ma hatahonon nasiam hubani na pinapansing ni Naibata, anjaha na sinuruh-Ni hu dunia on, ʻSiapasi Naibata do Ham,ʼ halani Huhatahon, Anak ni Naibata do Ahu?

37.text: Ambit lang Huhorjahon horja ni Bapa, age ulang porsaya nasiam Bangku.

38.text: Tapi anggo Huhorjahon do, hape lang porsaya nasiam Bangku, bani horja in ma nasiam porsaya, ase ibotoh anjaha itanda nasiam, ibagas Ahu do Bapa in, anjaha Ahu ibagas Bapa in.”

39.text: Dob ai sihol ma tangkapon ni sidea Ia, tapi maluah do Ia hun tangan ni sidea.

40.text: Dob ai laho ma Ia use hu dipar ni bah Jordan, ai ma hu pandidian ni si Johannes hinan, lanjar marianan ijai.

41.text: Anjaha buei do halak na roh marayak-Si, nini sidea ma, “Seng adong namin ibahen si Johannes tanda halongangan, tapi haganup na hinatahon ni si Johannes pasal Halak on, sintong do.”

42.text: Jadi buei do halak, na gabe porsaya Bani ijai.

1.text: Adong ma sada halak na boritan, si Lasarus, na hun Betania, ai ma huta ni si Maria ampa si Marta saninani ai.
1.title: Mulak Manggoluh si Lasarus

2.text: Ai ma si Maria, na ongga mamminaki Tuhan in, dob ai na mangapusi nahei-Ni marhitei jambulanni. Botouni do si Lasarus na boritan ai.

3.text: Isuruh botouni ai ma na mangkatahon Bani, “Ham Tuhan, boritan do na hinaholongan ni uhur-Mu!”

4.text: Mambogei ai Jesus, nini ma, “Sedo hamatean ujung ni naborit ai, tapi bahen hasangapon ni Naibata do ai, ase marsangap Anak ni Naibata marhitei ai.”

5.text: Tapi holong do uhur ni Jesus bani si Marta, bani saninani ai ampa bani si Lasarus.

6.text: Anjaha dob ibogei na boritan do ia, soh ope Ia dua ari nari bani ianan-Ni ai.

7.text: Dob salpu ai, nini ma hubani susian-Ni ai, “Eta, laho ma hita use hu Judea!”

8.text: Nini susian-Ni ai ma hu Bani, “Guru, baru ope sihol pargijigon ni halak Jahudi Ham, ai ulakan-Mu ope hujai?”

9.text: Balos ni Jesus, “Ai lang sapuluh dua jam do sadari? Barang ise na mardalan arian, seng tartolsu ai, ai ididah do panondang ni dunia on.

10.text: Tapi barang ise na mardalan borngin, tartolsu do, ai seng dong panondang bani.”

11.text: Dob ihatahon sonai, nini ma hubani sidea, “Ia si Lasarus, huan-huanta ai, domma modom; tapi na laho ma Ahu hujai mamuhoisi.”

12.text: Jadi nini susian-Ni ai ma hu Bani, “Ham Tuhan, anggo na modom do ia, na laho malum do.”

13.text: Pasal parmateini do na hinatahon ni Jesus ai; tapi ninuhur ni sidea pasal na sinok modom do.

14.text: Jadi ihatahon Jesus ma torang bani sidea, “Domma matei si Lasarus,

15.text: anjaha halani hanima malas do uhur-Hu lang ijai ahu, ase porsaya hanima; tapi laho ma hita marayaksi.”

16.text: Marsahap ma si Tomas, na ginoran si Rindu-rindu, hubani hasomanni susian ai, “Eta ma tongon laho, ase rap matei hita pakon-Si!”

17.text: Jadi dob das ijai, domma pala ompat ari ia ibagas tanoman jumpah-Si.

18.text: Ia huta Betania, dohor do ai hun Jerusalem, hira-hira tolu batu do daohni.

19.text: Buei do roh halak Jahudi marayak si Marta pakon si Maria, laho mangapoh sidea halani botou ni sidea ai.

20.text: Dob ibogei si Marta na dob roh Jesus, laho ma ia mangalo-alo-Si; tading i rumah do anggo si Maria.

21.text: Jadi nini si Marta ma bani Jesus, “Ambit ijon Ham Tuhan, seng matei botouhin!

22.text: Tapi sonari pe, hubotoh do, atap aha pe ipindo Ham humbani Naibata, sai na bereon-Ni do Bamu.”

23.text: Ihatahon Jesus ma hu bani, “Na laho puho do botoumai!”

24.text: Nini si Marta ma hu Bani, “Eak, hubotoh do, na puho do ia bani parpuhoon simagira.”

25.text: Ihatahon Jesus ma hu bani, “Ahu do parpuhoon ampa hagoluhan. Sai manggoluh do na porsaya Bangku, age pe matei ia.

26.text: Anjaha ganup na manggoluh anjaha na porsaya Bangku, seng anjai matei ia sadokah ni dokahni! Porsaya do ho ijai?”

27.text: Nini ma hu Bani, “Eak Tuhan, porsaya do ahu, Ham do Kristus, Anak ni Naibata, na roh hu dunia on.”

28.text: Jadi dob ihatahon sonai, laho ma ia mandilo si Maria, anggini ai, ihusipkon ma, “Domma roh Guru in, idilo do ho!”

29.text: Mambogei ai si Maria tarolos ma ia jongjong, laho manjumpahkon-Si,

30.text: ai lape das Jesus i huta ai, tapi bani parjumpahan-Ni pakon si Marta ai ope Ia.

31.text: Ia halak Jahudi na adong i rumah ai rap pakon si Maria, laho mangapohsi, dob ididah sidea tarolos si Maria jongjong laho hu darat, iirikkon sidea ma ia, ai iagan sidea na laho hu tanoman do ia tangis.

32.text: Das honsi si Maria hu parsaranan ni Jesus, anjaha ijin ididah Ia, manrogop ma ia hu lobei-Ni, anjaha ihatahon ma, “Ambit ijon Ham Tuhan, seng matei botouhai!”

33.text: Dob ididah Jesus ia na tangis ai, sonai homa halak Jahudi hasomanni na roh ai tangis-tangis do, jadi manringis ma Ia anjaha bulinsah,

34.text: lanjar nini ma, “Ija do itibalhon nasiam ia?” Nini sidea ma hu Bani, “Roh ma Ham, anjaha idah Ham ma, Tuhan!”

35.text: Jesus pe tangis ma.

36.text: Jadi nini halak Jahudi ma, “Tongor ma, holong ni uhur-Ni in bani!”

37.text: Tapi deba humbani sidea mangkatahon, “Ia, na mangungkab mata ni na mapitung, seng tarbahen-Si gakni, ase ulang matei halak on?”

38.text: Jadi manringis ma use Jesus, das honsi Ia hu tanoman ai. Batu na niliang do ai, lanjar batu do tutupni.

39.text: Nini Jesus ma, “Angkat nasiam ma batu in!” Jadi nini si Marta, botou ni na dob matei ai ma, “Tuhan, domma marbau, ai domma pala ompat ari ia matei.”

40.text: Nini Jesus ma hu bani, “Ai lang domma Huhatahon bam, idahonmu do hasangapon ni Naibata, anggo porsaya ho?”

41.text: Jadi iangkat sidea ma batu ai. Mangkawah ma Jesus dompak babou anjaha nini ma, “Ham Bapa, tarima kasih ma Bamu, halani itangihon Ham Ahu!

42.text: Hubotoh do, tongtong do Ahu itangihon Ham, tapi halani na mabuei, na jongjong maringgot on do, ase Huhatahon in, ase porsaya sidea, na sinuruh-Mu do Ahu.”

43.text: Jadi dob ihatahon sonai, ipagogoh ma sora-Ni mandilohon, “Lazarus, kaluar ma ho!”

44.text: Jadi luar ma tongon na matei ai; lilit ope hiou bani naheini ampa tanganni sonai hiou panrungkub bani bohini. Ihatahon Jesus ma, “Tanggali nasiam ma ia, ase boi ia mardalan.”

45.text: Jadi buei ma humbani halak Jahudi, na roh hubani si Maria ai, na gabe porsaya Bani, dob ididah sidea na binahen ni Jesus.

46.text: Tapi deba humbani sidea laho do marayak halak Parisei, laho patugahkon na binahen ni Jesus ai bani sidea.
46.title: Sihol Bunuhon ni Sintua ni Malim ampa Parisei Jesus

47.text: Jadi iadongkon sintua ni malim ampa Parisei ma rapot banggal, ihatahon sidea ma, “Aha ma bahenonta? Ai buei do tanda ibahen Halak in!

48.text: Anggo ipaturut hita Ia sonin, porsaya ma halak haganupan Bani, gabe roh ma holi halak Rom manrampas tanohta ampa bangsanta.”

49.text: Tapi sada humbani sidea, ai ma si Kayapas, sintua ni malim bani na satahun ai mangkatahon bani sidea, “Na hurang uhur do nasiam!

50.text: Seng ipingkirhon nasiam, paboa dearan do matei sada halak mangkopkop halak na mabuei in, humbani na magou ganup bangsa in.”

51.text: Sedo humbani dirini ihatahon ai; tapi halani sintua ni malim do ia bani na satahun ai, ase ijahai, na sihol matei ma Jesus mangkopkop bangsa in.

52.text: Seng pitah mangkopkop bangsa in, tapi sihol patumpuon-Ni do age anak ni Naibata na marserak in ase gabe sada in.

53.text: Mulai humbani ari ai manriah ma sidea laho mamunuh-Si.

54.text: Jadi lang be talar-talar mardalani Jesus i tongah-tongah ni halak Jahudi, tapi laho ma Ia hunjai hu sada nagori, dohorhon halimisan, hu huta na margoran Efraim; ijai ma Ia marianan ampa susian-Ni ai.

55.text: Tapi dohor ma Pesta Paskah ni Jahudi, jadi buei ma halak na tangkog hun nagori ai hu Jerusalem, paima Paskah ai, laho manguras dirini.

56.text: Ipindahi sidea ma Jesus, anjaha marsisungkunan ma sidea, sanggah jongjong-jongjong sidea i rumah panumbahan ai. Sonaha do ninuhur nasiam? Na so roh do Ia nani hu pesta on?

57.text: Ai domma iparentahkon sintua ni malim ampa Parisei, ase ipatugah anggo adong na mambotoh, atap ija Ia marianan, ase boi tangkapon ni sidea Ia.

1.text: Onom ari nari paima Paskah ai, das ma Jesus hu huta Betania, ianan ni si Lasarus, na pinuhoan ni Jesus humbani na matei.
1.title: Iminaki si Maria Tuhan Jesus

2.text: Jadi ipasirsir sidea ma ijai sipanganon Bani, anjaha si Marta do marugas; si Lasarus ma sada hasomanni, na mangan ai ijai.

3.text: Jadi ibuat si Maria ma sakati minak nardus na maharga anjaha na so maragu; iminaki ma nahei ni Jesus, anjaha jambulanni do ibahen manlapui. Jadi igoki misbou ni minak ai ma rumah ai.

4.text: Sada humbani susian-Ni, ai ma si Judas Iskariot, na sihol mantahihon-Si ai, mangkatahon,

5.text: “Mase ma lang na jual minak in harga tolu ratus dinar, ase naberehon in bani halak na masombuh?”

6.text: Ihatahon pe sonai, sedo na masombuh sinarihonni ijai; panangko do ia tene, anjaha halani ia sijolom parduitan, somal do ia buat-buat hunjai.

7.text: Jadi nini Jesus ma, “Paturut ma ia, ai ibahen do in sahira hubani ari pananom-Ku.

8.text: Ai tongtong do adong na masombuh i tongah-tongahnima, tapi anggo Ahu, seng totap i lambungnima.”

9.text: Jadi buei ma humbani halak Jahudi na mambotoh, na dob ijai Ia; jadi marrohan ma sidea, sedo pitah halani Jesus, tapi sihol idahon ni sidea do homa si Lasarus na dob pinapuho ai humbani na matei.
9.title: Sihol Bunuhon ni Sintua ni Malim Age si Lasarus

10.text: Ia sintua ni malim domma manriah hinan sihol mamunuh si Lasarus homa,

11.text: ai halanisi buei do halak Jahudi na laho hujai, gabe porsaya bani Jesus.

12.text: Patarni ai, dob ibogei halak na mabuei, na roh bani pesta ai, na roh ma Jesus hu Jerusalem,
12.title: Parmasuk ni Jesus hu Jerusalem

13.text: jadi ibuat sidea ma bulung-bulung ni palem, laho mangalo-alo-Si lanjar mandilo-dilohon, “Hosianna! Pinasu-pasu ma na roh marhitei goran ni Tuhan in, Raja ni Israel!”

14.text: Jadi dapot Jesus ma sada halode ajar-ajar, ai ma iajak domu hubani na tarsurat in,

15.text: “Ulang ho mabiar, ale boru Sion. Tonggor ma, Rajamu do na roh, mangajak halode poso-poso.”

16.text: Seng dong iarusi susian-Ni ai hinan pasal ai; dob pe marsangap Jesus, ase idingat sidea, na marhahonaan hu Bani do hape na tarsurat ai ampa pambahen ni sidea hu Bani.

17.text: Lanjar isaksihon halak na mabuei, na rap pakon-Si ai do, paboa na dob idilo do si Lasarus humbani tanoman, laho mamuhoi-Si humbani na matei.

18.text: Ase ialo-alo halak na mabuei ai pe Ia, halani na dob ibogei sidea do tanda halongangan na binahen-Ni ai.

19.text: Jadi nini halak Parisei ma samah sidea, “Tonggor ma, na so marguna do hape na binahen nasiam in, ai ganup do dunia on mangirikkon-Si.”

20.text: Adong do deba halak Gorik i tongah-tongah ni halak na tangkog ai, laho martonggo bani ari Pesta ai.
20.title: Sihol Idahon ni Halak Gorik Jesus

21.text: Jadi iparayak sidea ma si Pilippus, na hun Betsaida, na i Galilea, nini sidea ma, “Tuannami, sihol do idahonnami Jesus.”

22.text: Laho ma si Pilippus patugahkon ai bani si Andreas; si Andreas pe laho ma rap pakon si Pilippus patugahkon ai bani Jesus.

23.text: Jadi nini Jesus ma mambalosi sidea, “Na dob jumpah ma panorangni, ase marsangap Anak ni Jolma in!

24.text: Na sintong tumang do na Huhatahon on bannima, seng na ganda omei in, anggo seng madabuh hu tanoh anjaha matei, dob pe matei, ase buei buahni.

25.text: Agouan hosah do na mangkaholongi hosahni, tapi na mangkasogamkon hosahni i dunia on, ai do na manramotkonsi das hu hagoluhan sisadokah ni dokahni.

26.text: Barang ise na sihol mambalosi Ahu, iirikkon ma Ahu; anjaha ia ija Ahu, ijai do juakjuak-Ku. Barang ise na mambalosi Ahu, pasangapon ni Bapa in do ia.

27.text: Na bulinsah do uhur-Hu nuan. Aha ma sihatahonon-Ku? Ham Bapa, paluah Ham ma Ahu humbani panorang on. Tapi tene, halani in do ase das Ahu bani panorang on.

28.text: Ham Bapa, pasangap Ham ma goran-Mu!” Dob ai roh ma sora hun nagori atas, “Domma Hupasangap, lanjar pasangapon-Ku do use!”

29.text: Ibogei halak na mabuei, na jongjong ijai ma ai, gabe ihatahon sidea ma, “Longgur do ai!” Na legan mangkatahon, “Malekat do na marsahap pakon-Si!”

30.text: Nini Jesus ma mambalosi, “Sedo halani Ahu ase roh sora ai, halani nasiam do.

31.text: Sonari ma mardalan uhum bani dunia on, sonari ma sipabalion raja ni dunia on.

32.text: Anggo Ahu, dob ipagijang Ahu hun dunia on, tarikon-Ku do haganup sidea Bangku.”

33.text: Ihatahon do ai laho patidakkon parmatei-Ni holi.

34.text: Ibalosi halak na mabuei ai ma Ia, “Ibogei hanami humbani titah in, na totap do Kristus in ronsi sadokah ni dokahni. Mase ma ihatahon Ham, maningon pagijangon do Anak ni Jolma in? Ise do Anak ni Jolma in?”

35.text: Jadi ihatahon Jesus ma bani sidea, “Tongkin nari mando Panondang in bani nasiam. Mardalan ma nasiam, sanggah bani nasiam ope Panondang in, ase ulang idorab na golap in nasiam; na mardalan bani na golap, seng ibotoh atap dompak ja do ia laho.

36.text: Sanggah bani nasiam ope Panondang in, porsaya ma nasiam bani Panondang in, ase gabe anak ni Panondang in nasiam!” Ai ma ihatahon Jesus, dob ai itadingkon ma sidea laho marponop.

37.text: Age pe sonai buei ni tanda ibahen i lobei ni sidea, seng porsaya sidea Bani,
37.title: Mase Lang Porsaya Halak Jahudi?

38.text: ase jumpah na hinatahon ni Nabi Jesayas, “Ham Tuhan, ise ma na porsaya bani ambilannami? Anjaha hagogohon ni Tuhan, bani ise ma in talar?”

39.text: Seng tarbahen sidea porsaya, ai sonon ope hata ni si Jesayas,

40.text: “Ipapitung do mata ni sidea, anjaha ipahengkeng uhurni, ase ulang marpangidah mata ni sidea, anjaha ulang marpangarusion uhur ni sidea; ulang mulak sidea, ulang malum sidea hubahen.”

41.text: Sonai do ihatahon si Jesayas, halani ididah hasangapon-Ni ai, anjaha isahapkon pasal-Si.

42.text: Age humbani sipambobai buei do na porsaya Bani, tapi halani biar ni sidea mangidah Parisei, seng ibagas na talar, ase ulang ipabali sidea humbani kuria,

43.text: ai holongan do uhur ni sidea bani hasangapon na humbani jolma, ase hasangapon na humbani Naibata.

44.text: Dob ai dilo-dilo ma Jesus, nini ma, “Na porsaya Bangku, sedo Ahu na hinaporsayaanni ai, tapi na marsuruh Ahu do.
44.title: Rimpun ni Pangajaran ni Jesus

45.text: Na mangidah Ahu, mangidah na marsuruh Ahu do.

46.text: Ahu do Panondang na roh hu dunia on, ase ulang marianan ibagas na golap sagala na porsaya Bangku.

47.text: Anggo adong na manangar hatang-Ku, hape seng ihorjahon, seng Ahu na manguhumisi; ai seng roh Ahu, laho manguhum dunia on, tapi laho paluahkon do.

48.text: Na manulak Ahu anjaha na so manjalo hatang-Ku, domma adong na manguhumsi; hata na Huhatahon ai do manguhumsi bani ari parpudi.

49.text: Ai seng humbani diring-Ku Ahu marsahap, tapi Bapa, na marsuruh Ahu, Ia do na mangaturhon Bangku pasal sisahapkonon-Ku ampa sihatahonon-Ku.

50.text: Anjaha Hubotoh, hagoluhan sisadokah ni dokahni do titah-Ni in. Ase na Huhatahon in, sonin ihatahon Bapa in Bangku, sonai do Huhatahon.”

1.text: Paima pesta Paskah ai, dob ibotoh Jesus, na roh ma panorangni manadingkon dunia on, laho marayak Bapa in, ipataridahkon ma holong-Ni ronsi ujungni na dong Bani i dunia on, songon pangkaholongi-Ni hinan bani sidea.
1.title: Iburihi Jesus Nahei ni Susian-Ni

2.text: Sanggah na mangan ai sidea, domma isuankon sibolis in partahi-tahian hubagas uhur ni si Judas Iskariot, anak ni si Simon.

3.text: Halani ibotoh Jesus do, na dob iondoskon Bapa in haganup hubagas tangan-Ni, Ia roh humbani Naibata anjaha mulak ma hubani Naibata,

4.text: gabe jongjong ma Ia humbani na mangan ai, itanggali ma baju ganjang-Ni, ibuat ma basahan lanjar igonditkon ma.

5.text: Dob ai iuseihon ma bah hu sambung, iburihi ma nahei ni susian-Ni ai, anjaha iapusi ma ai merhitei basahan na ginonditkon-Ni ai.

6.text: Das ma Ia hubani si Simon Petrus, jadi nini si Petrus ma hu Bani, “Mintor Ham ma Tuhan mamurihi naheihu?”

7.text: Nini Jesus ma mambalosisi, “Seng iarusi ho nuan na Hubahen on, tapi arusanmu do ai use.”

8.text: Nini si Petrus ma hu bani, “Lalab ma lang bulih Ham mamburihi naheihu.” Nini Jesus ma mambalosisi, “Anggo seng Huburihi ho, seng parrupei ho Bangku.”

9.text: Nini si Simon Petrus ma, “Tuhan, ulang ma pitah naheihu, dihut ma tangan pakon ulungku!”

10.text: Dob ai nini Jesus ma hu bani, “Halak na dob pinaridi, seng pala burihan be (sobali naheini), ai domma borsih ia ganupan. Na dob borsih do hanima, tapi seng haganup.

11.text: Ai ibotoh do, na sihol mantahihon-Si, halani ai do, ase ihatahon, “Seng haganup hanima borsih!”

12.text: Ase, dob iburihi Jesus nahei ni sidea, ipakei ma use baju ganjang-Ni, hundul ma Ia, lanjar nini ma bani sidea, ai iarusi hanima do na Hubahen in bennima?

13.text: Igoran hanima do Ahu Guru anjaha Tuhan, anjaha sintong do pangkatahonnima in, ai in do Ahu tongon.

14.text: Ase anggo Tuhan anjaha Gurunima mamurihi naheinima, patut ma age hanima marsiburihan nahei!

15.text: Ai sitiruon do Hubere bannima, ase ibahen hanima songon na Hubahen in bennima.

16.text: Na sintong tumang do na Huhatahon on bannima, seng banggalan juakjuak marimbang tuanni, anjaha seng banggalan na sinuruh marimbang na marsuruhsi.

17.text: Anggo ibotoh hanima ma in, martuah ma hanima na mangkorjahonsi.

18.text: Seng dompak hanima ganupan hatang-Kin, Hutanda do na dob Hutodoh. Tapi ase saud na tarsurat in, ʻNa mangan ruti rap pakon Ahu, in do na manadahkon neheini dompak Ahu.ʼ
18.title: Ipatalar Jesus Sipartahi-tahi ai

19.text: Hupatugah hinan in bannima paima masa, ase porsaya hanima, anggo masa ma in, paboa Ahu do in.

20.text: Na sintong tumang do na Huhatahon on bannima, na manjalo na Husuruh, Ahu do na jinaloni ai, anjaha na manjalo Ahu, manjalo na marsuruh Ahu do.”

21.text: Dob ihatahon Jesus ai, bulinsah ma Ia, nini ma manaksihon, “Na tongon tumang do na Huhatahon on bennima: Sahalak hun bennima sihol mantahihon Ahu.”

22.text: Marsikawahan ma susian ai, jut ma uhur ni sidea, atap ise do na hinatahon-Ni ai.

23.text: Sada humbani susian ai, na hinaholongan ni Jesus, hundul dohor i lambung-Ni.

24.text: Jadi ihilap si Petrus ma ia, ihatahon ma bani, “Sungkun ma, ise do na hinatahon-Ni ai!”

25.text: Ipadohor ma hu lambung ni Jesus, nini ma hu Bani, “Tuhan, ise do ai?”

26.text: Ibalosi Jesus ma ia, “Hu bani ise Huberehon na santopik on, dob Husornobkon, ai ma ia.” Jadi isornobkon ma ruti na santopik ai, iberehon ma ai bani si Judas Iskariot, anak ni si Simon ai.

27.text: Jadi dob ijalo ai, masuk ma sibolis bani. Ihatahon Jesus ma hu bani, “Podas ma bahen sibahenonmin!”

28.text: Tapi seng dong humbani sidea na mangan ai, na mangarusi na hinatahon-Ni ai.

29.text: Ai halani si Judas do sijolom parduitan ai, gabe iagan na deba ma, na ihatahon Jesus do ia mamboli na porlu bani pesta ai, atap marsibere-bere bani na masombuh.

30.text: Ase dob ijalo si Judas na santopik ai, mintor laho ma ia hu darat, tapi domma bagas borngin.

31.text: Jadi dob laho ia hu darat, ihatahon Jesus ma, “Sipasangapon ma nuan Anak ni Jolma in, anjaha Naibata marsangap marhiteihon-Si.
31.title: Titah na Baru Pasal na Marsihaholongan

32.text: Anggo marsangap Naibata marhiteihon-Si, pasangapon ni Naibata ma Ia ibagas Dirini, anjaha barah ma Ia pasangapon-Ni.

33.text: Hanima anak-anakku, tongkin nari mando Ahu rap pakon hanima. Pindahannima ma Ahu; songon na dob Huhatahon bani halak Jahudi, sonai do hatahonon-Ku bannima, seng tarbahen hanima roh hubani siparayakon-Kai.

34.text: Titah na baru do Hubere bannima, ai ma, ase marsihaholongan hanima samah hanima. Songon holong ni uhur-Hu bannima, sonai ma marsihaholongan hanima.

35.text: Hunjon ma botohon ni ganup halak susian-Ku hanima, anggo marsihaholongan hanima.”

36.text: Nini si Simon Petrus ma, “Tuhan, huja Ham laho?” Balos ni Jesus, “Seng tarihutkon ho ope Ahu bani siparayakon-Kai anggo sonari, use pe ase ihutkononmu Ahu.”
36.title: Lumba-lumba Pasal Pamarsouon ni si Petrus

37.text: Nini si Petrus ma hu Bani, “Tuhan, mase lang tarihutkon ahu Ham sonari? Hosahku pe ra do ahu memberehon mangkopkop Ham!”

38.text: Balos ni Jesus, “Hosahmu berehononmu mangkopkop Ahu? Na sintong tumang do na Huhatahon on bam, lape martahuak dayok, domma tolu hali Ahu parnalangonmu.”

1.text: Ulang ma tonjan uhurnima! Porsaya ma hanima bani Naibata, anjaha porsaya ma homa Bangku!
1.title: Jesus do Dalan hu Hagoluhan

2.text: Buei do ianan i rumah ni Bapa. Ambit lang sonai, mintor hatahonon-Ku ma bannima, na laho do Ahu pasirsirhon ianan bannima?

3.text: Anjaha laho pe Ahu pasirsirhon ianan bannima, mulak do Ahu use mangalop hanima, ase rap hanima pakon Ahu.

4.text: Anjaha ibotoh hanima do dalan hu ianan siparayakon-Kai.”

5.text: Nini si Tomas ma hu Bani, “Seng ibotoh hanami atap huja do Ham laho Tuhan! Sonaha ma pambotohnami bani dalan ai?”

6.text: Nini Jesus ma hu bani, “Ahu do dalan in pakon hasintongan ampa hagoluhan. Seng dong na das hubani Bapa in, anggo seng marhiteihon Ahu.

7.text: Anggo itanda hanima Ahu, tandaonnima do age Bapa in. Olat ni on tandaonnima ma Ia anjaha idahonnima.”

8.text: Nini si Pilippus ma hu Bani, “Tuhan, patuduhkon Ham ma bannami Bapa in, ase sombuh uhurnami!”

9.text: Nini Jesus ma hu bani, “Domma pala na sain dokah Ahu rap pakon hanima, lanjar seng itandai ho ope Ahu, ale Pilippus? Na mangidah Ahu, na mangidah Bapa in do. Mase ma hatahononmu, ʻPatuduhkon Ham ma bannami Bapa in?ʼ”

10.text: Seng porsaya ho, Ahu ibagas Bapa in anjaha Bapa in ibagas Ahu? Hata na Huhatahon bannima, seng humbani diring-Ku Huhatahon in. Bapa in, na marianan ibagas Ahu, Ia do na mandalankon horja-Ni.

11.text: Porsaya ma hanima Bangku. Ibagas Bapa in do Ahu, anjaha ibagas Ahu do Bapa in. Anggo lang, halani horja in ma hanima porsaya!

12.text: Na sintong tumang do na Huhatahon on bannima, horjahonon ni na porsaya Bangku do songon horja na Hubahen in; lobih hunjai ope bahenonni, ai na laho ma Ahu hubani Bapa in.

13.text: Ase barang aha pe sipindoonnima marhitei goran-Ku, bahenon-Ku do, ase marsangap Bapa in ibagas Anak in.

14.text: Barang aha ipindo hanima hun Bangku marhitei goran-Ku, bahenon-Ku do ai.”

15.text: “Anggo na holong do uhurnima Bangku, dalankononnima do titah-Ku.
15.title: Bagah-bagah Pasal Tonduy Na Pansing

16.text: Anjaha pindoon-Ku ma bani Bapa in, ase ibere bannima sada Pangapiti na legan, ase Ia ma mangkasomani hanima lalab,

17.text: in ma Tonduy hasintongan in, na so tarjalo dunia on, ai seng ididah anjaha seng itanda. Tapi itanda hanima do Ia, ai na rap ma Ia pakon hanima, anjaha ibagas hanima ma Ia.

18.text: Seng tadingkonon-Ku hanima tading maetek; na roh ma Ahu marayak hanima.

19.text: Tongkin nari mando, seng be idahon ni dunia on Ahu, tapi idahonnima do Ahu, ai manggoluh do Ahu, hanima pe manggoluh do.

20.text: Bani na sadari ai ma botohonnima. Ahu ibagas Bapa, hanima ibagas Ahu anjaha Ahu ibagas hanima.

21.text: Barang ise na manjolom titah-Ku anjaha idalankon, ai do na marholong ni uhur Bangku. Ihaholongi Bapa do na marholong ni uhur Bangku, anjaha Ahu pe holong do uhur-Hu bani, anjaha patalaron-Ku do diring-Ku bani.”

22.text: Ihatahon si Judas ma Bani (sedo si Iskariot ai), “Tuhan, aha do halani, ase pitah bannami patalaron-Mu diri-Mu, seng bani dunia on?”

23.text: Nini Jesus ma mambalosisi, “Barang ise na marholong ni uhur Bangku, horjahononni in do hatang-Ku, jadi haholongan ni Bapa ma ia, gabe roh ma hanami marayaksi, anjaha marianan bani.

24.text: Na so marholong ni uhur Bangku, seng dalankononni in hatang-Ku, anjaha hata na binogeinima in, sedo Ahu simada in, tapi Bapa, na marsuruh Ahu do.

25.text: In ma Huhatahon bennima, sanggah rap ope Ahu pakon hanima.

26.text: Tapi anggo pangapiti in, sisuruhon ni Bapa in marhitei goran-Ku, ajarhonon anjaha pagolpaon ni In do bannima sagala na Huhatahon in bannima.

27.text: Damei do Hutadingkon bannima, damei na adong Bangku do Hubere bannima. Seng songon pambere ni dunia on pambereng-Ku bannima. Ulang ma tonjan anjaha ulang ma mabiar uhurnima.

28.text: Domma ibogei hanima hatang-Ku bannima, na laho ma Ahu, anjaha na roh ma Ahu marayak hanima. Ambit na holong uhurnima Bangku, malas do uhurnima halani laho Ahu marayak Bapa in, ai banggalan do Bapa in ase Ahu.

29.text: Anjaha sonari Hupatugah hinan ma in bannima, paima masa, ase porsaya hanima masa honsi.

30.text: Seng be buei sahapkonon-Ku bannima, ai na roh ma raja ni dunia on. Seng dong kuasani Bangku;

31.text: tapi sihol do botohon ni dunia on, na holong do uhur-Hu bani Bapa in, anjaha sonaha ihatahon Bapa in, sonai do Huhorjahon. Ai pe, jongjong ma hanima, laho ma hita hunjon!”

1.text: “Ahu do hayu anggur na tongon, anjaha Bapa do sihorjai pohon in.
1.title: Jesus do Hayu Anggur in

2.text: Irotap do sagala ranting-Ku na so marbuah, anjaha ipaborsih do sagala na marbuah, ase ganda buahni.

3.text: Domma borsih hanima halani hata in, na Huhatahon bannima.

4.text: Totap ma hanima ibagas Ahu, songon Ahu ibagas hanima! Songon ranting in, na so tarbahen marbuah humbani dirini sandiri, anggo seng totap bani hayu anggur in, sonai ma hanima, anggo seng totap hanima ibagas Ahu.

5.text: Ahu do hayu anggur in, hanima do ranting in. Na marianan ibagas Ahu, anjaha Ahu ibagas dirini, in ma na marbuahkon buei, seng tarhorjahon hanima age aha, anggo seng marhasoman Ahu.

6.text: Barang ise, na so marianan ibagas Ahu, ambukkonon do ai songon ranting ai gabe masak; ipatumpu ma ai, igijigkon hubagas apuy, jadi mosog ma.

7.text: Anggo marianan hanima ibagas Ahu, anjaha marianan hatang-Ku ibagas hanima, Ahu bannima, jumpah hanima do barang aha pe ipindo uhurnima.

8.text: Marhitei ai marsangap ma Bapang-Ku, anggo ramos buahnima, anjaha gabe susian-Ku hanima.”

9.text: “Songon pangkaholongi ni Bapa Bangku, sonai do holong ni uhur-Hu bannima. Totap ma hanima ibagas holong ni uhur-Hu.
9.title: Ojur-ojur Pasal na Marsihaholongan

10.text: Anggo ihorjahon hanima titah-Ku, marianan ma hanima ibagas holong ni uhur-Hu, songon Ahu na mangkorjahon titah ni Bapa, gabe marianan ibagas holong ni uhur-Ni.

11.text: Ase Huhatahon pe in bannima, ase marianan malas ni uhur-Hu ibagas hanima, anjaha gok malas ni uhurnima.

12.text: On ma titah-Ku, ase marsihaholongan hanima samah hanima, songon Ahu na mangkaholongi hanima.

13.text: Seng dong holong sibanggalan, anggo iberehon sada halak hosahni mangkopkop hasomanni.

14.text: Huan-Ku ma hanima, anggo ihorjahon hanima na Hutitahkon in bannima.

15.text: Seng Hugoran be hanima jabolon, ai seng ibotoh jabolon na hinorjahon ni tuanni; huan-huan do hanima Huhatahon, ai domma Hupabotohkon bannima, na Hutangar humbani Bapa.

16.text: Sedo hanima mamilih Ahu, tapi Ahu do mamilih hanima, anjaha Hupabangkit do hanima, ase laho hanima marbuah, anjaha ase totap buahnima ai, ase ibere bannima sagala sipindoonnima humbani Bapa in marhitei goran-Ku.

17.text: On ma Hutitahkon bannima, marsihaholongan ma hanima samah hanima!”

18.text: “Anggo idomdomi dunia on hanima, botoh hanima ma, na dob parlobei do Ahu idomdomi.
18.title: Lumba-lumba ni Jesus Pasal Pangayak-ayakon Bani Susian

19.text: Ambit na hun dunia on hanima, haholongan ni dunia on do hasomanni, halani seng hun dunia on hanima, tapi Ahu do mamilih hanima hun dunia on, ai do ase idomdomi dunia on hanima.

20.text: Ingat hanima ma hata na dob Huhatahon bannima, seng banggalan jabolon humbani tuanni. Anggo iparburu sidea Ahu, hanima pe parburuonni do. Anggo idalankon sidea hatang-Ku, dalankononni do age hatanima.

21.text: Tapi haganupan ai bahenon ni sidea do bannima halani goran-Ku, ai seng itanda sidea na marsuruh Ahu.

22.text: Ambit seng roh Ahu mansahapkon ai bani sidea, seng mardousa sidea ijai; tapi sonari seng dong be sidalian ni sidea manrungkub dousa ni sidea.

23.text: Na marsogam ni uhur dompak Ahu, sogam do uhurni homa age dompak Bapa.

24.text: Ambit lang Huhorjahon horja i tongah-tongah ni sidea, na so ongga hinorjahon ni jolma, seng mardousa sidea ijai; tapi domma ididah sidea in sonari, anjaha sogam do uhur ni sidea Bangku age bani Bapa.

25.text: Tapi maningon saud do hata na tarsurat ibagas Buku Titah ni sidea, ʻSogam do uhur ni sidea Bangku, seng dong marhala!ʼ

26.text: Ase rohkonsi Sipangapiti in, sisuruhon-Ku bannima humbani Bapa in, in ma Tonduy Hasintongan in, na roh humbani Bapa in, Ia do manaksihon pasal Ahu.

27.text: Tapi dihut ma hanima manaksihon, ai hasoman-Ku do hanima humbani mungkahni.”

1.text: “Haganupan in Huhatahon bennima ase ulang sangsi hanima holi.

2.text: Pabalion ni sidea do hanima hun rumah parguruan (sinagoge), anjaha na roh ma panorangni gabe songon na manggalang bani Naibata do na mamunuh hanima, ninuhur ni sidea.

3.text: Sonai do bahenon ni sidea halani lang itandai sidea Bapa in, age Ahu.

4.text: Tapi Hupatugah hinan in bannima, ase idingat hanima bani panorangni masa in, paboa na dob Huhatahon do in bannima. Seng humbani mungkahni Hupatugah in bannima, halani rap ope Ahu pakon hanima.

5.text: “Tapi na laho ma Ahu nuan marayak na marsuruh Ahu, anjaha seng dong age ise hun bennima na manungkun Ahu, ʻNa laho huja do Ham?ʼ
5.title: Ulih Halani Parmisir ni Jesus; Horja ni Tonduy Na Pansing

6.text: Lambin pusok tene uhurnima, halani Huhatahon in bannima.

7.text: Tapi na sintong do na Huhatahon on bannima, ulihnima do in anggo laho Ahu. Ai ambit seng laho Ahu, seng anjai roh Sipangapiti in bannima, tapi anggo laho Ahu, suruhon-Ku do Ia bannima.

8.text: Anggo roh Ia, ajaran-Ni do dunia on pasal dousa, pasal hapintoron ampa pasal uhum.

9.text: Anggo pasal dousa, ai ma na so porsaya sidea Bangku.

10.text: Anggo pasal hapintoron, ai ma na laho Ahu marayak Bapa, gabe seng idahonnima be Ahu.

11.text: Anggo pasal uhum, ai ma na dob hona uhum raja ni dunia on.

12.text: Buei ope namin sihatahonon-Ku bannima, tapi seng tarboan hanima ope ai sonari.

13.text: Tapi rohkonsi Tonduy Hasintongan in, arahkonon-Ni do hanima hubagas sagala hasintongan; ai seng adong humbani Dirini sihatahonon-Ni, tapi na binogei-Ni, ai do hatahonon-Ni, anjaha patugahon-Ni do bannima na sihol masa ope.

14.text: Pasangapon-Ni do Ahu, ai buaton-Ni do na dong Bangku, laho mangambilankonsi bannima.

15.text: Haganup na bani Bapa in, na dong Bangku do in; halani ai do ase Huhatahon, buaton-Ni do na dong Bangku, laho mangambilankon-Si bannima.”

16.text: “Tongkin nari mando, gabe seng idahonnima be Ahu, dob ai tongkin nari use, idahonnima ma Ahu.”
16.title: Isahapkon Jesus Pasal Parmisir-Ni ampa Parroh-Ni use

17.text: Gabe nini susian ai ma samah sidea, “Aha do arti ni na hinatahon-Ni in banta, ʻTongkin nari mando seng idahonnima be Ahu, dob ai tongkin nari use, idahonnima ma Ahu,ʼ ambah ni ai, ʻna laho ma Ahu bani Bapa in?ʼ”

18.text: Jadi nini sidea ma, “Aha do artini hata, ʻTongkin nari mandoʼ? Seng ibotoh hita artini ai.”

19.text: Ibotoh Jesus ma, sihol roh sidea manungkun-Si, gabe nini ma dompak sidea, “Na marsisungkunan do hanima pasal na Huhatahon in, ʻTongkin nari mando seng idahonnima be Ahu,ʼ dob ai, ʻTongkin nari use idahonnima ma Ahu?ʼ

20.text: Na sintong tumang do na Huhatahon on bannima, na laho tangis ma hanima anjaha mandoruhi, tapi malas ma uhur ni dunia on. Pusok do anggo uhurnima, tapi marubah ma pusok ni uhurnima gabe malas ni uhur.

21.text: Pusok do uhur ni parinangon manubuhkon dakdanakni anggo jumpah ma panorangni. Tapi dob tubuh dakdanak ai, seng be idingat na maborit ai, ibahen malas ni uhurni, halani na dob tubuh sada jolma hu dunia on.

22.text: Bannima pe nuan pusok ni uhur do, tapi idahon-Ku do hanima use, gabe marmalas ni uhur ma hanima, anjaha ise pe lang boi mambuat malas ni uhur ai hun bennima.”

23.text: Seng sungkunonnima be Ahu bani na sadari ai. Na tongon tumang do na Huhatahon on bannima, atap aha pe sipindoonnima humbani Bapa in, sai na bereon-Ni do marhitei goran-Ku.
23.title: Pasal Tonggo Ibagas Goran ni Jesus

24.text: Ronsi sonari seng ope mangindo hanima marhitei goran-Ku. Pindo hanima ma, ase manjalo hanima, ase gok malas ni uhurnima!

25.text: Marhitei limbaga do Husahapkon in bannima. Na roh ma panorangni, seng marlimbaga be Ahu marsahap pakon hanima, tapi torang-torang ma baritahonon-Ku bannima pasal Bapa in.

26.text: Bani ari ai ma hanima mangindo marhitei goran-Ku, anjaha seng Huhatahon bannima, Ahu manonggohon hanima bani Bapa in,

27.text: ai Bapa in sandiri mangkaholongi hanima, halani na dob holong uhurnima Bangku, anjaha na dob porsaya hanima, Ahu roh humbani Naibata.

28.text: Na bingkat humbani Bapa in do Ahu roh hu dunia on; tadingkonon-Ku ma use dunia on, laho marayak Bapa in.”

29.text: Nini susian-Ni ai ma, “Sonari pe, ase torang hata-Mu, seng songon limbaga be.

30.text: Sonari ma ibotoh hanami, paboa ibotoh Ham do haganup, anjaha seng pala porlu Bamu, sungkunon ni atap ise Ham. Halani ai ma, ase porsaya hanami, na bingkat humbani Naibata do Ham.”

31.text: Ibalosi Jesus ma sidea, “Porsaya ma hanima sonari?

32.text: Na roh ma panorangni anjaha domma roh in nuan, mambur merap ma hanima, ganup marsitohu dalanni, anjaha tadingkononnima ma Ahu punjung; tapi seng punjung Ahu tene, ai Bapa in do hasoman-Ku.

33.text: Huhatahon hinan in bannima, ase mardamei hanima ibagas Ahu. Hamarsikon do rupeinima i dunia on, tapi tenger ma uhurnima, domma Hutaluhon dunia on.”

1.text: In ma ihatahon Jesus. Dob ai mangkawah ma Ia dompak babou, nini ma, “Ham Bapa, domma jumpah panorangni, pasangap Ham ma Anak-Mu, ase ipasangap Anak-Mu Ham.
1.title: I. Tonggo-Ni Pasal Diri-Ni Sandiri

2.text: Ai domma ibere Ham kuasa Bani manrajai sagala jolma, laho mamberehon hagoluhan na sadokah ni dokahni bani haganup jolma, na binerehon-Mu Bani.

3.text: Ia hagoluhan sisadokah ni dokahni, in ma, anggo itanda sidea Ham, Naibata sisada-sada in, na sintong in, ampa Jesus Kristus, na sinuruh-Mu.

4.text: Domma Hupasangap Ham i tanoh on, ai domma Hudobkon horja, na binere-Mu Bangku, sihorjahonon-Ku.

5.text: Sonari pe Bapa, pasangap Ham ma Ahu hu lambung-Mu, songon sangap-Ku sanggah i lambung-Mu Ahu, sanggah lape adong dunia on.”

6.text: “Domma Hupatalar Goran-Mu bani jolma na binere-Mu in Bangku hun dunia on. Ham hinan do simada sidea, anjaha ibere Ham do sidea Bangku; iramotkon sidea do hata-Mu.
6.title: II. Tonggo-Ni Mangapiti Susian-Ni

7.text: Sonari, domma ibotoh sidea, na hun Bamu do haganup na binere-Mu in Bangku.

8.text: Ai domma Huondoskon bani sidea hata na binere-Mu in Bangku; domma ijalo sidea hata in, anjaha torang ibotoh sidea Ahu bingkat hun Bamu, anjaha domma porsaya sidea, Ham do marsuruh Ahu.

9.text: Hutonggohon do sidea. Sedo dunia on Hutonggohon, sidea on do, na binere-Mu in Bangku, ai Ham do simada sidea.

10.text: Anjaha sagala na adong Bangku, na adong Bamu do in, anjaha na adong Bamu, na adong Bangku do in, anjaha domma marsangap Ahu ibagas sidea.

11.text: Seng be i dunia on Ahu, tapi i dunia on ope sidea, anjaha na roh ma Ahu marayak Ham. Ham Bapa na mapansing, ramotkon Ham ma ibagas goran-Mu, sidea na binere-Mu in Bangku, ase sada sidea songon Hita.

12.text: Sadokah rap Ahu pakon sidea, Ahu do manramotkon ibagas goran-Mu, sidea na binere-Mu in Bangku, anjaha Hujagai, gabe seng dong na magou humbani sidea, sobali jolma magou in, ase saud hata ni Surat in.

13.text: Tapi na roh ma Ahu nuan marayak Ham, anjaha ganupan in Husahapkon sanggah i dunia on ope Ahu, ase gok bani sidea malas ni uhur na Bangku in.

14.text: Domma Huondoskon hata-Mu bani sidea; sogam do uhur ni dunia on bani sidea, ai seng humbani dunia on sidea, songon Ahu na so hun dunia on.

15.text: Seng Hupindo, ase buaton-Mu sidea hun dunia on, tapi ase iramotkon Ham do sidea dompak pangagou.

16.text: Seng hun dunia on sidea, songon Ahu na so hun dunia on.

17.text: Papansing Ham ma sidea ibagas hasintongan; hata-Mu do hasintongan.

18.text: Songon parsuruh-Mu Bangku hu dunia on, sonai do Husuruh sidea hu dunia on.

19.text: Hupapansing do diring-Ku mangkopkop sidea, ase gabe pansing sidea ibagas hasintongan.”

20.text: “Sedo pitah sidea Hutonggohon, tapi dihut do na sihol porsaya Bangku, halani hata ni sidea,
20.title: III. Tonggo-Ni Mangkopkop Sagala na Porsaya Bani

21.text: ase sada sidea haganup, songon Ham Bapa ibagas Ahu, anjaha Ahu ibagas Ham, sonai ma age sidea ibagas Hita, ase porsaya dunia on, Ham do marsuruh Ahu.

22.text: Domma Huberehon bani sidea hasangapon na binere-Mu in Bangku, ase sada sidea, songon Hita na sada.

23.text: Ahu ma ibagas sidea, anjaha Ham ibagas Ahu, ase gok dear ni hasadaon ni sidea, gabe ibotoh dunia on, Ham do na marsuruh Ahu anjaha na holong do uhur-Mu bani sidea, songon holong ni uhur-Mu Bangku.

24.text: Ham Bapa, sihol do uhur-Hu, ia ijin Ahu, ijin ma pakon na binere-Mu in Bangku, ase ididah sidea hasangapon-Ku, na binere-Mu in Bangku, ai domma holong uhur-Mu Bangku, paima tombei dunia on.

25.text: Ham Bapa na bonar, ia lang pe itanda dunia on Ham, anggo Ahu Hutanda do Ham, anjaha ibotoh sidea on, Ham do marsuruh Ahu.

26.text: Domma Hupabotohkon bani sidea goran-Mu, anjaha pabotohkonon-Ku do ope, ase ibagas sidea holong ni uhur-Mu na hu Bangku in, anjaha ase Ahu ibagas sidea.”

1.text: Jadi dob ihatahon Jesus sonai, misir ma Ia rap pakon susian-Ni hu dipar ni Bah Kidron. Adong ma ijai sada pohon, hujai ma Ia laho pakon susian-Ni.
1.title: Tartangkap Tuhan Jesus i Getsemane

2.text: Tapi ibotoh si Judas, sipartahi-tahi ai do homa ianan ai, ai gati do Jesus hujai rap pakon susian-Ni.

3.text: Ia si Judas, iarahkon ma tentara ampa juakjuak ni malim ampa Parisei, jadi ijumpahkon ma hujai, marrigapan, marsuluh ampa marsinjata.

4.text: Halani ibotoh Jesus do haganupan na sihol masa Bani, roh ma Ia manjumpahkon sidea, nini ma hubani sidea, “Ise do na pinindahan nasiam?”

5.text: Nini sidea mambalosi, “Jesus, na hun Nazaret!” Nini Jesus ma hubani sidea, “Ahu do in!” Dihut do si Judas sipartahi-tahi ai jongjong i lambung ni sidea.

6.text: Sanggah ihatahon hubani sidea, “Ahu do in,” surut ma sidea mangkatompas hu tanoh.

7.text: Dob ai iulaki ma manungkun sidea, “Ise do na pinindahan nasiam?” Jadi nini sidea ma, “Jesus na hun Nazaret!”

8.text: Balos ni Jesus, “Domma Huhatahon bani nasiam, ʻAhu do in!ʼ Anggo Ahu do na pinindahan nasiam, palopas nasiam ma laho halak on.

9.text: Ase saud hata na hinatahon in, ʻSeng dong na magou age sada humbani na binere-Mu in Bangku.ʼ”

10.text: Ia si Simon Petrus marpodang do, isintak ma ai anjaha itampulhon hubani jabolon ni sintua ni malim ai, gabe rotap ma pinggolni siamun. Si Malkus do goran ni jabolon ai.

11.text: Ihatahon Jesus ma hubani si Petrus, “Sarungkon ma podangmin! Ai lang maningon inumon-Ku do panginuman, na binere ni Bapa in Bangku?”

12.text: Dob ai itangkap tentera ampa kopala ni sidea pakon juakjuak ni Jahudi ai ma Jesus, lanjar isangkut ma.

13.text: Jadi iboan sidea ma Ia parlobei bani si Hannas, ai ma tulang ni si Kayapas, sintua ni malim bani na satahun ai.

14.text: Ai ma si Kayapas, na mangkatahon hinan bani Jahudi, “Dearan do matei sada halak mangkopkop bangsa in.”

15.text: Ia si Simon Petrus pakon susian na sada nari, iirikkon sidea do Jesus. Na marsitandaan do susian na sada ai ampa sintua ni malim ai, jadi masuk ma ia rap pakon Jesus hu alaman ni rumah ni sintua ni malim ai.
15.title: Pamorsouon ni si Petrus na Parlobei bani Tuhan Jesus

16.text: Tapi jongjong do si Petrus i darat dohorhon labah. Jadi luar ma susian na sada ai, na marsitandaan pakon sintua ni malim ai, marsahap ma ia pakon naboru sijaga labah ai, gabe iarahkon ma si Petrus hubagas.

17.text: Jadi nini naboru sijaga labah ai ma bani si Petrus, “Ai lang ho do sada susian ni halak on?” Balos ni si Petrus, “Sedo ahu in!”

18.text: Tapi na jongjong do ijai jabolon pakon juakjuak mandadang bani pandadangan, na pinagara ni sidea halani borgohni. Rap pakon sidea do jongjong si Petrus mandadang ijai.

19.text: Jadi isungkun sintua ni malim ai ma Jesus pasal susian-Ni ampa pasal podah-Ni.
19.title: Tuhan Jesus i Lobei ni si Hannas

20.text: Ibalosi Jesus ma ia, “Torang-torang do hatang-Ku bani halak na mabuei. Tongtong do Ahu mangajari i parguruan pakon i rumah panumbahan, ai ma ianan partumpuan ni ganup halak Jahudi, anjaha seng dong marponopan Ahu marsahap.

21.text: Mase Ahu isungkun ham? Sungkun ham ma sidea, na mambogei hatang-Kai! Ibotoh sidea do na Huhatahon ai.”

22.text: Dob ihatahon Jesus sonai, ipastap sada juakjuak na jongjong ijai ma Ia, lanjar nini ma, “Mintor sonai ma parbalos-Mu bani sintua ni malim in?”

23.text: Nini Jesus ma mambalosisi, “Anggo na salah parsahap-Kai, patugah ham ma salahni, tapi anggo na sintong do, mase ma ipastap ham Ahu?”

24.text: Ase isuruh si Hannas ma Ia sangkut hubani sintua ni malim, na margoran si Kayapas.

25.text: Ia si Simon Petrus ijai ope jongjong mandadang. Jadi nini sidea ma hu bani, “Ai lang ho do sada susian-Ni?” Jadi iporsou ma nini ma, “Seng ahu in!”
25.title: Parmorsouon ni si Petrus na Paduahalihon pakon na Patoluhalihon

26.text: Dob ai roh ma sada halak humbani juakjuak ni sintua ni malim, ai ma sindohor ni parpinggol na tinampul ni si Petrus ai, mangkatahon hu bani, “Ai lang huidah do ho rap pakon-Si i pohon ai?”

27.text: Jadi iporsou si Petrus ma use, dob ai mintor martahuak ma dayok.

28.text: Jadi girah sogod, iboan sidea ma Jesus hun lobei ni si Kayapas hu benteng ai. Tapi seng masuk sidea hu benteng ai, ase ulang tarpantang sidea, laho mangankon Paskah ai.
28.title: Tuhan Jesus i Lobei ni si Latus

29.text: Jadi luar ma si Latus manjumpahkon sidea, nini ma, “Pasal aha do pangaduan nasiam dompak Halak on?”

30.text: Nini sidea ma mambalosisi, “Ambit seng siparjahat Halak on, seng anjai ondoskononnami Ia bamu.”

31.text: Nini si Latus ma hubani sidea, “Boan nasiam ma Ia, uhumi nasiam ma Ia domu hubani aturan nasiam.” Nini halak Jahudi ma hu bani, “Seng bulih bunuhonnami atap ise pe.”

32.text: Ase jumpah ma ijai na hinatahon ni Jesus hinan pasal dalan ni parmatei-Ni.

33.text: Jadi masuk ma use si Latus hubagas benteng ai, idilo ma Jesus anjaha nini ma hu Bani, “Atene, Ham do Raja ni Jahudi?”

34.text: Ibalosi Jesus ma, “Na humbagas uhurmu do na hinatahonmu in, atap hata ni halak do in bamu pasal Ahu?”

35.text: Ibalosi si Latus ma, “Ai halak Jahudi do ahu? Bangsa-Mu ampa sintua ni malim ai do padaskon Ham bangku. Ai aha dong ihorjahon Ham?”

36.text: Balos ni Jesus, “Ia Harajaon-Ku seng na hun dunia on ai. Ambit na hun dunia on Harajaon-Ku, seng tarbahen lang manlawan juakjuak-Ku, ase ulang hona ondoskon Ahu hubani halak Jahudi; tapi seng sisonin Harajaon-Kin!”

37.text: Jadi nini si Latus ma hu Bani, “Ase Raja do Ham?” Balos ni Jesus, “Songon na hinatahonmu in ma tongon. Raja do Ahu! Ase tubuh pe Ahu, anjaha ase roh pe Ahu hu dunia on, laho manaksihon hasintongan in do. Barang ise na humbani hasintongan, tangihononni in do sorang-Ku.”

38.text: Nini si Latus ma hu Bani, “Aha do hasintongan?” Jadi dob ihatahon sonai, luar ma ia use marayak Jahudi, nini ma hubani sidea, “Seng dong jumpah ahu salah-Ni!

39.text: Tapi tene, somal do hupaluah sada halak bani nasiam sanggah Paskah. Marosuh do nasiam, ase hupaluah bani nasiam Raja ni Jahudi in?”

40.text: Gabe isurakkon sidea ma use, “Ulang Ia! Si Barabas ma!” Tapi panrampok do anggo si Barabas.

1.text: Dob ai itogu si Latus ma Jesus anjaha ihatahon ma Ia lonsingan.
1.title: Hona Arsik-arsik ampa Hona Apasan Jesus

2.text: Idandan tentara ai ma sada sortali humbani ranting-ranting na marduri anjaha inahkon ma ai hubani ulu-Ni; ibahen ma Ia homa marbaju sigerger.

3.text: Dob ai roh ma sidea hu lobei-Ni, nini ma, “Tabi ma Bamu, ale Raja ni Jahudi!” Lanjar ipastapi ma Ia.

4.text: Luar ma si Latus, ihatahon ma hubani halak Jahudi, “Tonggor ma, huboan do Ia hu lobei nasiam, ase ibotoh nasiam, na so adong jumpah ahu salah-Ni.”

5.text: Jadi luar ma Jesus marsotali duri anjaha marbaju sigerger. Ihatahon si Latus ma bani sidea, “Tonggor nasiam ma Jolma in!”

6.text: Jadi dob ididah sintua ni malim ampa juakjuak ai Ia, idilohon sidea ma, “Parsilangkon, parsilangkon ma Ia!” Ihatahon si Latus ma bani sidea, “Boan nasiam ma Ia anjaha parsilangkon nasiam ma! Seng dong jumpah ahu salah-Ni.”
6.title: Hona Uhum Tuhan Jesus

7.text: Ibalosi halak Jahudi ma ia, “Adong do undang-undang bannami, anjaha mangihutkon undang-undang ai maningon marutang hosah do Ia, ai Anak ni Naibata do Ia,” nini.

8.text: Mambogei ai si Latus, lambin mabiar ma ia,

9.text: gabe masuk ma ia use hu kantorni, ihatahon ma hubani Jesus, “Ai na hunja do Ham?” Tapi seng ibalosi Jesus ia.

10.text: Dob ai ihatahon si Latus ma hu Bani, “Mase lang ra Ham marsahapkon ahu? Ai lang ibotoh Ham, na markuasa do ahu paluahkon Ham, anjaha na markuasa do ahu mamparsilangkon Ham?”

11.text: Balos ni Jesus, “Seng markuasa ham Bangku, ambit lang na ibere ai bamu hun datas. Halani ai banggalan do dousa ni na mangondoskon Ahu bamu.”

12.text: Olat ni ai nari ipindahi si Latus ma dalan laho paluahkon-Si. Tapi marsurak-surak ma halak Jahudi, nini sidea ma, “Anggo ipaluah ham Ia, seng hasoman ni kesar in be ham! Ai barang ise na mangangkat dirini gabe raja, na mangimbang kesar do ai.”

13.text: Ase dob ibogei si Latus hata ai, iboan ma Jesus hu darat lanjar hundul ma ia bani hotak paruhuman, bani ianan na margoran Dasor Batu, bani hata Heber, ʻGabbatha.ʼ

14.text: Ai ma na masa bani ari parugason Paskah, marayak tongah ari. Ihatahon si Latus ma hubani halak Jahudi, “Tonggor nasiam ma Raja nasiam on!”

15.text: Tapi mardilo-dilo ma sidea, “Padaoh, padaoh ma Ia! Parsilangkon ma!” Nini si Latus ma hubani sidea, “Mintor parsilangkononku ma Raja nasiam?” Jadi ibalosi sintua ni malim ma, “Seng dong rajanami sobali kesar!”

16.text: Dob ai iondoskon ma Ia bani sidea ase iparsilangkon; jadi ijalo sidea ma Jesus.

17.text: Lanjar Ia do mamorsan hayu parsilang ai, laho hu ianan na margoran partangkurakan; Golgata do goranni bani hata Heber.
17.title: Iparsilangkon Tuhan Jesus

18.text: Ijai ma iparsilangkon sidea Ia rap pakon dua halak na legan, sada i siamun, sada i sambilou, anjaha Jesus i tongah-tongah ni sidea.

19.text: Ibahen si Latus ma sada surat anjaha ilongkotkon ma ai bani hayu parsilang ai. Sonon do hatani, “Jesus, halak Nazaret, Raja ni Jahudi.”

20.text: Buei do halak Jahudi, na mambasa surat ai, ai dohor do hun huta ai iparsilangkon Jesus, anjaha tarsurat do ai bani hata Heber, hata Rom ampa hata Gorik.

21.text: Dob ai ihatahon pangintuai ni halak Jahudi ma hubani si Latus, “Ulang suratkon ham, ʻRaja ni Jahudi,ʼ tapi na hinatahon-Ni ai ma, ʻAhu do Raja ni Jahudi!ʼ”

22.text: Balos ni si Latus, “Na dob husurat, na dob husurat ma in!”

23.text: Ase dob iparsilangkon tentara ai Ia, ibuat sidea ma hiou-Ni, ibagi ompat ma ai, ganup sidea sabagian, ambah ni ai baju ganjang-Ni ai. Ia baju ganjang ai seng marpanjaruman, na tinonun do ai torus.

24.text: Nini sidea ma samah sidea, “Ulang ma rigat hita on, manjomput na sinurat ma hita pasal on, atap bani ise on.” Jadi jumpah ma na tarsurat in, na mangkatahon, “Ibagi sidea do hiou-Hu, anjaha manjomput na sinurat do sidea pasal bajung-Ku.” Ase sonai ma pambahen ni tentara ai.

25.text: Jongjong do i lambung parsilang ni Jesus ai inang-Ni, sanina ni inang-Ni, si Maria parinangon ni si Kleopas, ampa si Maria Magdalena.
25.title: Iondoskon Jesus Inang-Ni hubani si Johannes

26.text: Anggo Jesus, dob ididah ijai do inang-Ni ampa susian haholongan ni uhur-Ni ai i lambungni, ihatahon ma bani inang-Ni ai, “Andin ma Inang, anakmu!”

27.text: Dob ai ihatahon ma bani susian-Ni ai, “Andin ma inangmu!” Olat ni ai nari ijalo susian ai ma ia hu rumahni.

28.text: Jadi dob ibotoh Jesus, na dob marujung haganup, ase jumpah na tarsurat ai nini ma, “Horahan Ahu!”
28.title: Parmatei ni Tuhan Jesus

29.text: Jadi adong ma ijai gusi na marisi anggur na migar. Isornobkon sidea ma limut hubagas anggur na migar ai, ilongkotkon sidea ma ai bani hayu ni hisop, anjaha isurdukkon ma hubani pamangan-Ni.

30.text: Dob ijalo Jesus na migar ai, nini ma, “Domma salosei!” Dob ai ipaunduk ma ulu-Ni anjaha iondoskon ma tonduy-Ni.

31.text: Halani ari parugasonkon do ai, anjaha ase ulang bani parsilang ai bangkei ai sanggah ari Sabat (ai ari na banggal do ari Sabat ai), jadi laho ma halak Jahudi hubani si Latus mangindohon, ase iparponggol ma nahei ni sidea anjaha ipasusur.

32.text: Jadi laho ma tentara ai, iparponggol sidea ma nahei ni sidua halak ai, na tarsilang rap pakon Jesus.

33.text: Tapi das honsi sidea bani Jesus, ididah ma na dob matei Ia, gabe seng be pala iparponggol sidea nahei-Ni.

34.text: Tapi ipantomkon sahalak humbani tentara ai ma tanjani bani tonton-Ni, gabe mintor luar ma daroh ampa bah.

35.text: Anjaha na mangidah ai do na manaksihon ai, anjaha sintong do na sinaksihonni ai. Ibotoh do, na sintong do na hinatahonni ai, andohar porsaya age nasiam.

36.text: Ase masa pe ai, ase saud do na tarsurat in, “Seng bulih ponggolhonon holi-holi-Ni!”

37.text: Anjaha surat na legan use mangkatahon, “Idahon ni sidea do na pinantom ni sidea in.”

38.text: Dob salpu ai ipindohon si Josep, na hun Arimatea ma hubani si Latus, atap boi do pasusuronni bangkei ni Jesus. Dihut do ia susian ni Jesus, tapi ponop do, halani biarni mangidah Jahudi. Jadi ibalosi si Latus ma ai, gabe laho ma ia pasusurhon bangkei ni Jesus.
38.title: Partanom ni Tuhan Jesus

39.text: Roh do homa si Nikodemus, ai ma na ongga roh marayak Jesus borngin-borngin, iboan do mir na maragu aloe hira-hira saratus kati.

40.text: Dob ai ibuat sidea ma bangkei ni Jesus, ibaluti ma ai bani hiou putih rap pakon na morum-morum ai, mangihutkon adat pananomon ni Jahudi.

41.text: Dohor bani ianan ni Jesus tarsilang ai, adong do sada pohon, anjaha ibagas pohon ai adong do sada tanoman na baru, seng ongga ope inahkon bangkei hujai.

42.text: Ase hujai ma itibalhon sidea Jesus, halani ari parugasonkon ai, ai dohor do tanoman ai.

1.text: Dob ai bani ari parlobei, dob salpu ari Sabat, laho ma si Maria hu tanoman, girah sogod, golap-golap ope, gabe ididah ma, na dob tarangkat batu ai hun tanoman ai.
1.title: Si Petrus ampa si Johannes Roh Manorih Tanoman

2.text: Jadi marlintun ma ia mangayaki si Simon Petrus ampa susian na sada nari, haholongan ni uhur ni Jesus, anjaha nini ma hubani sidea, “Adong do na mambuat Tuhan in hun tanoman, anjaha seng ibotoh hanami, huja Ia inahkon!”

3.text: Jadi laho ma si Petrus ampa susian na sada nari, gabe das ma sidea hu tanoman ai.

4.text: Na rap marlintun do sidea na dua ai, tapi hinsahan do susian na sada nari ai humbani si Petrus, gabe parlobei ma ia das hu tanoman ai.

5.text: Jadi ipaunduk ma dirini, ididah ma tibal pambaluti ai, tapi seng masuk anggo ia.

6.text: Roh ma homa si Petrus hun pudini, imasuki ma tanoman ai, jadi ididah ma tibal pambaluti ai.

7.text: Ia hiou pamalut ni ulu-Ni, seng rap ai pakon pambaluti ai, pulig do ai ilompit bani ianan na legan.

8.text: Dob ai masuk ma homa susian na sada nari ai, na parlobei das hu tanoman ai, ididah ma, gabe porsaya ma ia.

9.text: Ai seng iarusi sidea ope hata ni Surat in, na mangkatahon, “Maningon puho do Ia humbani na matei.”

10.text: Dob ai mulak ma susian na dua ai.

11.text: Ia si Maria, jongjong do idarat ni tanoman ai tangis-tangis, anjaha sanggah na tangis ai ia, ipaunduk ma dirini manonggor hubagas tanoman ai.
11.title: Ipataridahkon Tuhan Jesus Diri-Ni hubani si Maria Magdalena

12.text: Gabe ididah ma hundul dua malekat ijai, marhiou silopak, sada hampit ulu-Ni, na sada nari hampit hatibalan ni nahei ni Jesus.

13.text: Jadi ihatahon sidea ma hu bani, “Mase tangis ham Inang?” Ihatahon ma bani sidea, “Adong do na mambuat Tuhanku, anjaha seng hubotoh huja Ia inahkon.”

14.text: Dob ihatahon sonai, marhusor ma ia dompak pudi, gabe ididah ma Jesus jongjong ijai, tapi seng ibotoh Jesus do ai hape.

15.text: Nini Jesus ma hu bani, “Ham Inang, mase tangis ham? Ise ipindahi ham?” Jadi iagan ma, sijaga pohon do Ia, gabe ihatahon ma Bani, “Anggo Ham do mambuat-Si, tuan, patugah Ham ma bangku, atap huja do Ia inahkon Ham, ase hualop!”

16.text: Dob ai nini Jesus ma hu bani, “Maria!” Jadi idompakkon si Maria ma Ia, nini ma ibagas hata Heber, “Rabbuni!” (artini: Guru)

17.text: Ihatahon Jesus ma hu bani, “Ulang jamah Ahu, ai seng naik ope Ahu hubani Bapa in! Tapi laho ma ho hubani saninang-Ku, hatahon ma hubani sidea, na laho tangkog ma Ahu hubani Bapang-Ku anjaha Bapanima, hubani Naibatang-Ku anjaha Naibatanima.”

18.text: Jadi laho ma si Maria Magdalena, ibaritahon ma hubani susian ai, “Domma huidah Tuhan in, anjaha on do hata-Ni bangku!”

19.text: Jadi dob bod ari, bani ari parlobei dob salpu ari Sabat ai, sanggah tutup sagala labah ni rumah, niiankon ni susian ai, halani biar ni uhur ni sidea mangidah halak Jahudi, roh ma Jesus jongjong hu tongah-tongah ni sidea, anjaha ihatahon ma bani sidea, “Damei ma bannima!”
19.title: Ipataridahkon Tuhan Jesus diri-Ni hubani Susian-Ni, Seng Dihut si Tomas

20.text: Jadi dob ihatahon sonai, ipatuduhkon ma tangan-Ni ampa tonton-Ni bani sidea, gabe malas ma uhur ni susian ai, halani na dob ididah sidea Tuhan in.

21.text: Dob ai ihatahon Jesus ma use bani sidea, “Damei ma bannima! Songon sinuruh ni Bapa in Ahu, sonai do suruhon-Ku hanima!”

22.text: Dob ihatahon sonai, manompul ma Ia dompak sidea, anjaha nini ma hubani sidea, “Jalo hanima ma Tonduy Na Pansing!

23.text: Anggo isasap hanima dousa ni atap ise pe, na dob sasap ma ai, anjaha anggo ipatotap hanima dousa ni atap ise pe, na totap ma ai.”

24.text: Tapi anggo si Tomas, sada humbani na sapuluh dua in, na margoran si Rindu-rindu, seng rap pakon sidea ia, sanggah na roh ai Jesus.
24.title: Ipataridahkon Tuhan Jesus Diri-Ni hubani Susian-Ni, Dihut si Tomas

25.text: Jadi ihatahon susian na legan ai ma dompaksi, “Domma ididah hanami Tuhan in!” Tapi ibalosi ma sidea, “Anggo seng huidah bani tangan-Ni ai bokas ni paku ondi, anjaha ijamah jari-jaringku bokas ni paku ondi, anjaha anggo seng hujamah tonton-Ni ai, seng porsaya ahu.”

26.text: Dob salpu ualuh borngin, tumpu ma use susian ai i rumah ondi, rap pakon si Tomas. Jadi roh ma Jesus, sanggah tutup sagala labah, jongjong hu tongah-tongah ni sidea, nini ma dompak sidea, “Damei ma bannima!”

27.text: Ihatahon ma hubani si Tomas, “Bahen hujon jari-jarimin, anjaha torih ma tangan-Ku! Surdukkon ma tanganmin, manjamah tonton-Hu. Ulang sangsi uhurmu, porsaya ma!”

28.text: Jadi nini si Tomas ma mambalosi-Si, “Ham Tuhanku anjaha Naibatangku!”

29.text: Jadi ihatahon Jesus ma hu bani, “Halani ididah ho Ahu, ai do ase porsaya ho. Martuah ma na porsaya age pe lang ididah!”

30.text: Buei ope tanda na legan, na binahen ni Jesus i lobei ni susian-Ni, na so sinuratkon ibagas buku on.
30.title: Tujuan ni Ambilan Na Madear

31.text: Ase nasuratkon pe on, ase porsaya nasiam, Jesus do Kristus, Anak ni Naibata, anjaha marhitei na mangkaporsayai ai dapotan hagoluhan nasiam ibagas goran-Ni.

1.text: Dob ai ipataridahkon Jesus ma use diri-Ni hubani susian ai i topi ni tao Tiberias. Sonon ma pardalanni.
1.title: Ipataridahkon Tuhan Jesus Diri-Ni hubani Susian i Topi Tao Tiberias

2.text: Tumpu ma si Simon Petrus pakon si Tomas, na margoran si Rindu-rindu, rap pakon si Natanael, na hun Kana i Galilea, pakon anak ni si Sebedeus ampa dua halak nari humbani susian-Ni ai.

3.text: Jadi nini si Simon Petrus ma hubani sidea, “Laho ma ahu mardengke.” Ihatahon sidea ma hu bani, “Dihut ma hanami!” Jadi laho ma sidea, masuk ma hu parau, tapi aha pe lang dapot sidea na saborngin ai.

4.text: Anjaha dob siang ari, jongjong ma Jesus i pasir ai, tapi seng itanda sidea Ia.

5.text: Jadi ihatahon Jesus ma hubani sidea, “Ambia, adong do dengkenima ijin?” Ibalosi sidea ma Ia, “Seng dong!”

6.text: Dob ai ihatahon ma bani sidea, “Dabuh hanima ma jalanima hu siamun ni parau in, ase dapotan hanima!” Jadi idabuh sidea ma, gabe seng tartarik sidea be jala ai halani buei ni dengke ai.

7.text: Jadi ihatahon susian haholongan ni Jesus ai ma hubani si Petrus, “Tuhan in do in!” Jadi dob itangar si Simon Petrus, Tuhan in do ai hape, ialitkon ma hiouni, ai seng marhiou ia hinan, gabe manlumpat ma ia hu tao ai.

8.text: Tapi marparau do anggo susian na legan ai, lanjar manarad jala na marisi dengke ai, ai seng sadiha daoh sidea hun darat, hira-hira dua ratus asta do.

9.text: Das honsi sidea hu darat, ididah sidea ma narnar ijai ampa dengke i atasni, ambah ni ai ruti.

10.text: Ihatahon Jesus ma hubani sidea, “Boan hanima ma deba dengke in, na dapot hanima in!”

11.text: Jadi naik ma si Petrus hu parau ai, isarad ma jala ai hu darat, gok dengke na banggal-banggal, saratus lima puluh tolu bueini, anjaha age pe sonai bueini, seng marigat anggo jala ai.

12.text: Dob ai nini Jesus ma hubani sidea, “Roh ma hanima!” Tapi seng dong humbani susian ai, na pag manungkun-Si, “Ise do Ham?” Ibotoh sidea, Tuhan in do ai.

13.text: Ase roh ma Jesus, ibuat ma ruti ai, ipambere ma ai bani sidea, sonai homa dengke ai.

14.text: Ai ma na patoluhalihon ipataridahkon Jesus diri-Ni hubani susian-Ni, dob puho Ia humbani na matei.

15.text: Ase dob mangan sidea, ihatahon Jesus ma hubani si Simon Petrus, “Ale Simon, anak ni si Jonas, holongan do uhur-Mu Bangku ase halak on?” Nini ma hu Bani, “Eak Tuhan, ibotoh Ham do holong ni uhurhu Bamu!” Ihatahon Jesus ma hu bani, “Parmahani ma anak ni biribiring-Ku!”
15.title: Ijalo Tuhan Jesus si Petrus Mulak gabe Susian-Ni

16.text: Ihatahon ma use paduahalihon bani, “Ale Simon, Anak ni si Jonas, holong do uhurmu Bangku?” Nini ma hu Bani, “Eak Tuhan, ibotoh Ham do holong ni uhurhu Bamu!” Jadi ihatahon ma hu bani, “Parmahani ma biribiring-Ku!”

17.text: Dob ai ihatahon ma patoluhalihon hu bani, “Ale Simon, anak ni si Jonas, holong do uhurmu Bangku?” Jadi pusok ma uhur ni si Petrus, halani patoluhalihon ma ihatahon hu bani, “Holong do uhurmu Bangku?” Jadi ihatahon ma, “Haganup do, ale Tuhan, ibotoh Ham; ibotoh Ham do holong ni uhurhu Bamu!” Dob ai ihatahon Jesus ma hu bani, “Parmahani ma biribiring-Ku!”

18.text: Na tongon tumang do na Huhatahon on bam, “Sanggah poso ho, ho do manggonditi dirimu, anjaha laho ho huja rosuh ni uhurmu. Tapi dob matua holi ho, surdukkononmu ma tanganmu, jadi gonditan ni halak na legan ma ho, anjaha boanonni ma ho hubani na so harosuh ni uhurmu.”
18.title: Ilumbahon Jesus Pasal Sonaha do Ujung ni Goluh ni si Petrus ampa si Johannes

19.text: Tapi ihatahon pe ai, laho patugahkon parmateini do use, laho pasangapkon Naibata. Jadi, dob ihatahon sonai, nini ma hu bani, “Ihutkon ma Ahu!”

20.text: Jadi marhusor ma si Petrus, gabe ididah ma mangihut susian haholongan ni uhur ni Jesus, ai ma na hundul darngos bani Jesus, sanggah na mangan ondi sidea, anjaha na manungkun-Si ijia, “Ise do in Tuhan, na sihol mantahihon Ham?”

21.text: Ase dob ididah si Petrus ia, nini ma hubani Jesus, “Ham Tuhan, sonaha ia ambia on?”

22.text: Nini Jesus ma hu bani, “Anggo marosuh Ahu, totap ia ronsi roh Ahu, mase ma pala pasari-sarionmu ai? Tapi anggo ho, ihutkon ma Ahu!”

23.text: Ase sar ma hata ai bani hasoman-hasoman ai, na so matei susian ai. Tapi seng ihatahon Jesus hu bani, na so matei ia, tapi sonon do nini, “Anggo marosuh Ahu, totap ia ronsi roh Ahu, mase ma pala pasari-sarionmu ai?”

24.text: Ai ma susian, na manaksihon pasal on anjaha na manuratkon, anjaha ibotoh hanami, na sintong do na sinaksihonni in.
24.title: Hata Panutup ni Buku on

25.text: Tapi buei ope na legan, na binahen ni Jesus; ambit nasuratkon ai sada-sada, ninuhurhu, ra seng siat i dunia on buku na sinurat ai.

1.text: Bani suratku na parlobei in, ale Teopilus, husuratkon do pasal haganup na binahen ampa podah na pinungkah ni Jesus,
1.title: Lobei ni Hata

2.text: das ronsi na tarangkat Ia, dob lobei ibere parentah marhitei Tonduy Na Pansing bani apostel-apostel, na dob pinilih-Ni ai.

3.text: Dob salpu hamarsikon na tinaron-Ni ai, ipataridahkon do diri-Ni manggoluh bani sidea marhitei buei tanda, ai ma ibagas siompat puluh ari na pinataridahkon-Ni ai diri-Ni bani sidea, lanjar mansahapkon pasal Harajaon ni Naibata.

4.text: Sanggah na rap Ia pakon sidea, iparentahkon ma bani sidea, “Ulang ma laho hanima hun Jerusalem, tapi paima hanima ma na binagahkon ni Bapa, na dob ibogei hanima hun Bangku.
4.title: Parnaik ni Tuhan Jesus

5.text: Ia si Johannes bah do ididihon, tapi Tonduy Na Pansing do didihonon-Ku bani nasiam, seng pala piga ari nari.”

6.text: Jadi sanggah na martumpu ai sidea, isungkun sidea ma Ia, nini ma, “Ham Tuhan, pajongjongon-Mu ma sonari use harajaon in bani Israel?”

7.text: Nini ma hubani sidea, “Seng urusannima ai mambotoh adanganni atap panorangni, na dob tinontuhon ni Bapa in ibagas kuasa-Ni sandiri.

8.text: Tapi jaloonnima ma hagogohon ni Tonduy Na Pansing na sogop bennima, anjaha gabe saksing-Ku ma hanima i Jerusalem ampa i sab Judea ampa i Samaria ampa das hu ujung ni tanoh on.”

9.text: Jadi dob ihatahon sonai, tarangkat ma Ia inonoi sidea, dob ai ilingodi hombun ma Ia humbani panonggor ni sidea.

10.text: Sanggah na ituludkon sidea ai Ia laho hu nagori atas, jongjong ma dua halak parhiou silopak i lambung ni sidea,

11.text: na mangkatahon, “Nasiam halak Galilea, mase ma sai jongjong nasiam kawah-kawah dompak datas? Anggo Jesus ai, na tarangkat hun lobei nasiam hu nagori atas, sonai do roh Ia, songon na nididah nasiam ai Ia naik hu nagori atas.”

12.text: Dob ai mulak ma sidea hu Jerusalem hun dolog ai, na margoran Dolog Jetun; dohor do ai hun Jerusalem, sada pardalanan Sabat do daohni.

13.text: Dob das sidea, tangkog ma sidea hu kamar pardatas ai, ianan ni sidea ai, ai ma si Petrus ampa si Johannes, si Jakobus ampa si Andreas, si Pilippus ampa si Tomas, si Bartolomeus ampa si Mateus, si Jakobus anak ni si Alpeus, ampa si Simon Selotes, ampa si Judas anak ni si Jakobus.

14.text: Sidea ai do haganup na marnunut marsada ni uhur martonggo rap pakon parinangon-parinangon ampa si Maria, inang ni Jesus, sonai homa anggi-Ni ai.

15.text: Bani panorang ai ma jongjong si Petrus i tongah-tongah ni sanina-sanina ai, bueini adong do hira-hira saratus dua puluh halak, nini ma,
15.title: Tarpilih si Matias gabe Apostel Gantih ni si Judas Iskariot

16.text: “Nasiam hasoman sanina, maningon saud do hata ni Surat in, na dob nilumbahon ni Tonduy Na Pansing hinan marhitei pamangan ni si Daud, ai ma pasal si Judas, na gabe pambobai ni sitangkap Jesus.

17.text: Masuk hinan do ia hubani bilangannami, anjaha dihut do ia bani jabatan on.

18.text: Dapotsi do sanlambar tanoh humbani upah hajahaton ai; anjaha sanggah tungkap ia madabuh, mapultak ma dagingni, gabe mandarat ma ganup bituhani.”

19.text: Anjaha haganup do pangisi ni Jerusalem mambotoh ai, mambahen igoran tanoh ai ibagas sahap ni sidea: Akeldamah, artini: Tanoh Daroh.

20.text: Ai tarsurat do ibagas buku Psalm, “Sai halong ma iananni ai, anjaha ulang ma adong na mangiankon ai!” Ambah ni ai, “Jaloon ni na legan ma jabatanni!”

21.text: Halani ai maningon adong do humbani sidea na mangkasomani hanami, sadokah marhujai-hujon Tuhan Jesus i tongah-tongahta,

22.text: olat ni pandidion ni si Johannes nari das hubani partarangkat-Ni ai hun banta, na gabe hasomannami manaksihon pasal parpuhoon-Ni ai.

23.text: Jadi ipajongjong sidea ma dua halak, ai ma si Josep, na margoran si Barsabas anjaha na ginoran homa si Justus, ampa si Matias.

24.text: Jadi martonggo ma sidea, nini ma, “Ham Tuhan, sitanda uhur ni haganup jolma, patuduh Ham ma barang ise do humbani na dua on ipilih Ham,

25.text: gabe sijalo jabatan diakon ampa apostel, na dob tinadingkon ni si Judas, na dob laho marayak siparayakonni.”

26.text: Lanjar manjomput na sinurat ma sidea, jadi dapot ma si Matias, gabe tarhira ma ia hasoman ni apostel na sapuluh sada ai.

1.text: Jadi sanggah jumpah ari Pentakosta, martumpu do sidea haganup bani sada ianan.
1.title: Parroh ni Tonduy Na Pansing

2.text: Jadi roh ma sompong sora hun langit songon parombus ni logou na gogoh montas, gabe igoki ma rumah ianan ni sidea na hundul ai.

3.text: Jadi taridah ma bani sidea usih hubani silah ni apuy na marjilam-jilam, anjaha sogop ma bani ganup sidea.

4.text: Gabe gok Tonduy Na Pansing ma sidea ganupan, jadi mamungkah marsahap na legan ma sidea ganupan, songon pambere ni Tonduy in bani sidea mansahapkonsi.

5.text: Tapi adong ma halak Jahudi na marianan i Jerusalem, ai ma halak na daulat humbani sagala bangsa na i toruh ni langit.

6.text: Sanggah na masa ai sora ai, martumpu ma na mabuei ai; jadi longang ma sidea, ai ganup do sidea mambogei hata ai ibagas sahapni bei.

7.text: Jadi malitonduy ma sidea anjaha longang, nini sidea ma, “Ai lang halak Galilea do sidea haganup na marsahap in?

8.text: Mase ma ganup hita mambogei ibagas hata ni tanoh hatubuhanta bei?

9.text: Hita, halak Partia pakon Media pakon Elamit ampa na marianan i Mesopotamia, i Judea ampa Kappadosia, i Pontus ampa i Asia,

10.text: i Prigia, Pampilia, Masir ampa i nagori Libia na hampit Kirene, ampa halak Rom na marianan ijon, halak Jahudi ampa parguru,

11.text: halak Kreta ampa halak Arab; ibagas hatanta bei do ibogei hita sidea mansahapkon habanggalon ni Naibata.”

12.text: Jadi longang ma sidea haganup, jut bei ma uhurni, nini ma samah sidea, “Ai aha do artini in?”

13.text: Tapi manrisai do na deba, nini ma, “Na bosurtu do in bani anggur na matobu.”

14.text: Jadi jongjong ma si Petrus rap pakon na sapuluh sada ai, ipagogoh ma sorani anjaha iparsahapkon ma sidea, “Nasiam halak Jahudi ampa haganup na marianan i Jerusalem, botoh nasiam ma on, anjaha parimbagaskon nasiam ma hatangku!
14.title: Ambilan ni si Petrus ampa Parjadi ni Kuria na Parlobei in

15.text: Seng na mabuk hanami on, songon pangagan ni uhur nasiam, ai pukul siah ope ari,

16.text: tapi na hinatahon ni Nabi Joel do na masa on, ai nini do,

17.text: ʻBani ari parpudi, nini Naibata, useihonon-Ku do humbani Tonduy-Hu bani sagala daging, jadi manjahai ma anak nasiam, sonai boru nasiam, anjaha marnipi ma na matua nasiam.

18.text: Age bani jabolon-Ku dalahi ampa jabolon-Ku naboru bani panorang ai, useihonon-Ku do humbani Tonduy-Hu, ase manjahai sidea.

19.text: Anjaha bahenon-Ku do halongangan bani langit i babou, anjaha tanda bani tanoh i toruh, ai ma daroh apuy ampa timus na maripul.

20.text: Mataniari ai gabe golap ma, anjaha bulan gabe daroh, parlobei ni ari parroh ni Tuhan in, na banggal anjaha na marmulia in.

21.text: Jadi sagala na mandilo goran ni Tuhan in, maluah ma.ʼ

22.text: Nasiam halak Israel, tangihon nasiam ma hata on: Ia Jesus, na hun Nasaret in, in ma na dob pinatandahon ni Naibata bani nasiam marhitei hagogohon, halongangan ampa tanda, na binahen ni Naibata marhiteihon-Si i tongah-tongah nasiam, songon na binotoh nasiam,

23.text: na dob niondoskon mangihutkon sura-sura ni Naibata na totap in ampa humbani pamotohan-Ni hinan, Ia do na dob iparsilangkon anjaha ibunuh nasiam marhitei tangan ni na so martitah.

24.text: Tapi ipapuho Naibata do Ia, dob itanggali haparngiton ni hamatean, ai seng tarjolomi hamatean in Ia.

25.text: Ai ihatahon si Daud do pasal ai, ʻHuidah do Tuhan in tongtong i lobeihu, ai i siamunku do Ia, ase ulang dugur ahu.

26.text: Halani ai malas do uhurhu, anjaha marolob-olob dilahku; dagingku pe marsaran do halani pangarapan.

27.text: Ai seng paturuton-Mu tonduyhu i nagori toruh, anjaha seng lopason-Mu Na Pansing-Mu mangidah hamarsikon.

28.text: Ipabotohkon Ham do bangku dalan hagoluhan, gokan-Mu do bangku malas ni uhur i lobei-Mu.ʼ

29.text: Nasiam sanina, huhatahon ma bani nasiam torang-torang, ia ompungta si Daud matei do anjaha hona tanom, anjaha i tongah-tongahta do tanomanni ronsi sadari on.

30.text: Halani nabi do ia, anjaha ibotoh, na dob ibijahon Naibata do bani, pabangkiton sahalak humbani ginomparni bani paratasni,

31.text: ibagas botohni hinan domma isahapkon pasal parpuhoon ni Kristus in, ai ma na so paturuton Ia i nagori toruh, atap idahon ni daging-Ni hamarsikon.

32.text: In ma Jesus, na dob pinapuho ni Naibata, haganup do hanami manaksihon ai.

33.text: Dob ipagijang Ia hu siamun ni Naibata, anjaha ijalo Tonduy Na Pansing na pinarbagah-bagah in humbani Naibata, gabe iuseihon ma in songon na nididah anjaha ibogei nasiam.

34.text: Ai seng si Daud naik hu nagori atas, tapi ihatahon do, ʻNini Tuhan in dompak Tuhanku: Hundul ma ho hu siamunkon,

35.text: paima Hubahen munsuhmu, gabe sidogei-dogeian bani naheimu.ʼ

36.text: Ase torang ma ibotoh haganup bangsa Israel: Ia Jesus na pinarsilangkon nasiam in, domma ipabangkit Naibata gabe Tuhan anjaha Kristus.”

37.text: Manangar ai, itorusi ma uhur ni sidea, gabe ihatahon sidea ma hubani si Petrus ampa hubani hasomanni apostel, “Aha ma sibahenonnami, nasiam hasoman?”

38.text: Ihatahon si Petrus ma hubani sidea, “Paubah nasiam ma uhur nasiam, anjaha padidihon nasiam ma ganup nasiam hubagas goran ni Jesus Kristus, bahen hasasapan ni dousa nasiam, ase ijalo sibere-bere ni Tonduy Na Pansing.

39.text: Ai bani nasiam do bagah-bagah in ampa bani anak nasiam ampa bani haganup halak na daoh, sidiloon ni Tuhan Naibatanta ope.”

40.text: Buei ope hata na legan isaksihon, laho mangojur sidea, nini do, “Paluah nasiam ma diri nasiam, humbani bangsa na geduk on!”

41.text: Jadi tardidi ma haganup na manjalo hatani ai, anjaha adong do hira-hira tolu ribu halak na tambah bani na sadari ai.

42.text: Anjaha totap do sidea bani podah ni apostel ampa ibagas parsaoran, ibagas na manopiki ruti ampa na martonggo.
42.title: Parsaoran ni Kuria na Parlobei in

43.text: Sogop do uhur na mabiar bani haganup; buei do halongangan ampa tanda ibahen apostel ai.

44.text: Sai sada do ganup na porsaya ai, anjaha parbagianan rup do ihira sidea arta ni sidea.
